en.s: The Battle of Peshawar was fought on 27 November 1001 between the Ghaznavid army of Mahmud of Ghazni and the Hindu Shahi army of Jayapala, near Peshawar. Jayapala was defeated and captured, and as a result of the humiliation of the defeat, he later immolated himself in a funeral pyre. This is the first of many major battles in the expansion of the Ghaznavid Empire into the Indian subcontinent by Mahmud.

zh.s: 1001年11月27日，伽色尼的马哈茂德率领伽色尼军队，在白沙瓦附近与贾亚帕拉率领的印度教夏希王朝军队交战。贾亚帕拉战败被俘，后来因蒙受战败羞辱而自焚。这是马哈茂德向印度次大陆扩张伽色尼帝国期间多场重大战役中的第一场。

en.t: The Council of Clermont was a mixed synod of ecclesiastics and laymen of the Catholic Church, called by Pope Urban II and held from 17 to 27 November 1095 at Clermont, Auvergne, at the time part of the Duchy of Aquitaine
en.s: The Council of Clermont was a mixed synod of ecclesiastics and laymen of the Catholic Church, called by Pope Urban II and held from 17 to 27 November 1095 at Clermont, Auvergne, at the time part of the Duchy of Aquitaine. While the council is known today primarily for the speech Pope Urban gave on the final day, it was primarily a synod focused on implementing the Cluniac reforms, enacting decrees and settling local and regional issues.

zh.t: 克莱蒙会议于1095年11月17日至27日在奥弗涅的克莱蒙举行
zh.s: 克莱蒙会议是天主教会的一次教士与世俗人士共同参加的会议，由教皇乌尔班二世召集，于1095年11月17日至27日在奥弗涅的克莱蒙举行。当时克莱蒙属于阿基坦公国。如今人们主要因乌尔班教皇在会议最后一天发表的演说而记得这次会议，但会议的主要议题是推行克吕尼改革、颁布法令，以及处理地方和区域事务。

en.s: The Battle of Cortenuova (sometimes spelled Cortenova) was fought on 27 November 1237 in the course of the Guelphs and Ghibellines Wars: in it, Holy Roman Emperor Frederick II defeated the Second Lombard League.

zh.s: 科尔泰诺瓦战役有时也拼作科尔特诺瓦战役，于1237年11月27日在圭尔夫派与吉伯林派的战争期间发生。神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈二世在战斗中击败了伦巴第第二联盟。

en.s: The Battle of Roosebeke (sometimes referred by its contemporary name as Battle of Westrozebeke) took place on 27 November 1382 on the Goudberg between a Flemish army under Philip van Artevelde and a French army under Louis II of Flanders who had called upon the help of the French king Charles VI after he had suffered a defeat during the Battle of Beverhoutsveld.

zh.s: 罗斯贝克战役又称西罗斯贝克战役，于1382年11月27日在豪德贝格发生。菲利普·范·阿特费尔德率领佛兰德军队，与路易二世·德·佛兰德斯率领的法国军队交战。路易二世此前在贝弗豪茨费尔德战役中战败，因此请求法国国王查理六世出兵相助。

en.s: The Siege of 's-Hertogenbosch of 1601 (Sitio de Bolduque de 1601 in Spanish) was an unsuccessful Dutch attempt led by Prince Maurice of Nassau and William Louis of Nassau-Dillenburg to capture the city of 's-Hertogenbosch, North Brabant, Spanish Netherlands, garrisoned by about 1,500–2,000 Spanish soldiers (2 infantry companies and 2 cavalry companies) led by Governor Anthonie Schetz, Baron of Grobbendonck, between 1 and 27 November 1601, during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604), in the context of the long and bloodiest Siege of Ostend. For this siege, the Prince Maurice mobilized seventy-three companies of infantry and thirty-three companies of cavalry, including several pieces of artillery.

zh.s: 1601年斯海尔托亨博斯围城战（西班牙语称1601年博尔杜克围城战）是八十年战争和英西战争期间荷兰军队试图夺取斯海尔托亨博斯的一次行动，由拿骚的莫里斯亲王和拿骚-迪伦堡的威廉·路易率领。该城位于西班牙属尼德兰的北布拉班特，驻有约1,500至2,000名西班牙士兵，由总督安托尼·谢茨、格罗本东克男爵指挥。围城从1601年11月1日持续至27日，最终荷兰军队未能攻下城池。此次行动发生在持续时间更长、伤亡更惨重的奥斯坦德围城战期间。莫里斯亲王调动了73个步兵连和33个骑兵连，并带有数门火炮。

en.s: The Battle of Julianstown was fought on 27 November 1641 near Julianstown in County Louth during the Irish Rebellion of 1641. A force sent by the Dublin government to reinforce the garrison of Drogheda was ambushed by Irish rebels and nearly destroyed.

zh.s: 朱利安斯敦战役于1641年11月27日在劳斯郡朱利安斯敦附近发生，是1641年爱尔兰起义的一部分。都柏林政府派出一支部队增援德罗赫达驻军，但遭爱尔兰叛军伏击，几乎全军覆没。

en.s: The Second Battle of Zrínyiújvár (Croatian: Novi Zrin) was fought on November 27, 1663, as part of the Austro-Turkish War (1663–1664), between the Kingdom of Hungary and the Kingdom of Croatia under the command of Ban Miklós Zrínyi and an Ottoman army. The battle took place near Zrínyiújvár (Zrínyi family's fortress) in present-day Croatia and was a Hungarian-Croatian victory.

zh.t: 第二次兹里尼新堡战役
zh.s: 第二次兹里尼新堡战役（克罗地亚语：诺维兹林）于1663年11月27日在奥土战争期间发生，交战双方为匈牙利王国和克罗地亚王国联军，以及奥斯曼军队。匈克联军由总督米克洛什·兹里尼指挥。战斗发生在今克罗地亚境内的兹里尼新堡（兹里尼家族的要塞）附近，以匈克联军获胜告终。

en.s: The 1755 Meknes earthquake affected Morocco on 27 November 1755. The earthquake had a moment magnitude (Mw) estimated at between 6.5 and 7.0. It devastated the cities of Fes and Meknes—killing at least 15,000 people in both cities. The earthquake struck less than a month after another earthquake that devastated Morocco and Lisbon on 1 November.

zh.s: 1755年11月27日，摩洛哥发生梅克内斯地震，震级估计为6.5至7.0级。非斯和梅克内斯两座城市遭到严重破坏，两地至少有15,000人死亡。此次地震发生在11月1日另一场地震重创摩洛哥和里斯本不到一个月后。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Virginia on November 27, 1783. The incumbent governor of Virginia Benjamin Harrison V was re-elected. The election was conducted by the Virginia General Assembly in joint session. The House of Delegates met on November 26 to make nominations for governor and other offices, which the Senate accepted without amendment.

zh.s: 1783年11月27日，弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举，现任州长本杰明·哈里森五世连任。选举由弗吉尼亚州议会两院联席会议进行。众议院于11月26日提名州长及其他官员，参议院未作修改便予以通过。

en.s: In the siege of Hüningen (27 November 1796 – 1 February 1797), the Austrians captured the city from the French. Hüningen is in the present-day Department of Haut-Rhin, France. Its fortress lay approximately 2.5 miles (4.0 km) north of the Swiss city of Basel and .5 miles (0.80 km) north of the spot where the present-day borders of Germany, France and Switzerland meet.

zh.s: 于宁根围城战发生于1796年11月27日至1797年2月1日，奥地利军队从法国手中夺取该城。于宁根今属法国上莱茵省。当地要塞位于瑞士城市巴塞尔以北约2.5英里（4.0公里），距离今德国、法国和瑞士三国交界处以北0.5英里（0.80公里）。

en.s: The 1806 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 27, 1806, in order to elect the governor of North Carolina. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Nathaniel Alexander was re-elected by the North Carolina General Assembly as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1806年11月27日，北卡罗来纳州举行州长选举。民主共和党籍现任州长纳撒尼尔·亚历山大在没有对手的情况下连任，由北卡罗来纳州议会选出。

en.s: The raid on Batavia was a successful attempt by a large Royal Navy force to destroy the Dutch navy squadron based in Java on 27 November 1806 during the Java campaign of 1806–1807.

zh.s: 1806年11月27日，英国皇家海军大部队成功突袭爪哇的巴达维亚，摧毁驻扎当地的荷兰海军分舰队。这是1806至1807年爪哇战役的一部分。

en.t: Constitution of the Kingdom of Poland
en.s: The Constitution of the Kingdom of Poland (Polish: Konstytucja Królestwa Polskiego) was granted to the 'Congress' Kingdom of Poland by King of Poland Alexander I of Russia in 1815, who was obliged to issue a constitution to the newly recreated Polish state under his domain as specified by the Congress of Vienna. It was considered among the most liberal constitutions of its time; however, it was never fully respected by the government.
en.n: Adoption of the Constitution of the Kingdom of Poland.

zh.s: 1815年，俄罗斯皇帝兼波兰国王亚历山大一世颁布《波兰王国宪法》，将其授予“会议王国”波兰。根据维也纳会议的安排，他有义务为其统治下重新建立的波兰国家颁布宪法。这部宪法被认为是当时较为自由的宪法之一，但政府从未完全遵守。
zh.n: 《波兰王国宪法》通过。

en.s: The 1833 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 27, 1833, in order to elect the governor of North Carolina. Incumbent Whig governor David L. Swain was re-elected by the North Carolina General Assembly as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1833年11月27日，北卡罗来纳州举行州长选举。辉格党籍现任州长戴维·L·斯温在没有对手的情况下连任，由北卡罗来纳州议会选出。

en.t: James Pratt and John Smith are hanged in London; they are the last two to be executed for sodomy in England
en.s: James Pratt (1805–1835), also known as John Pratt, and John Smith (1795–1835) were two British men who, in November 1835, became the last people to be executed for sodomy in England. Pratt and Smith were arrested in August of that year after allegedly having "carnal knowledge" of each other in a room rented by another man, William Bonill.

zh.t: 詹姆斯·普拉特和约翰·史密斯在伦敦被处决
zh.s: 詹姆斯·普拉特（亦称约翰·普拉特）和约翰·史密斯是两名英国男子，1835年11月成为英格兰最后两名因同性性行为被处决的人。二人于当年8月被捕，罪名是据称在威廉·博尼尔租来的房间里发生同性性行为。

en.s: The Pastry War began in November 1838 when French naval forces blockaded ports in Mexico, and captured San Juan de Ulúa in Veracruz. This was in response to allegations of mistreatment of French nationals in Mexico, including a pastry chef after whom the war was named, and ended in March 1839 with a British-brokered peace. A Second French intervention in Mexico followed in the 1860s.

zh.s: 糕点战争于1838年11月爆发。法国海军封锁墨西哥港口，并攻占韦拉克鲁斯的圣胡安·德乌卢阿堡。法国采取军事行动，是为了回应法国侨民在墨西哥遭受虐待的指控，其中包括一名糕点师，战争也因此得名。战争于1839年3月结束，由英国斡旋达成和平协议。19世纪60年代，法国再次干预墨西哥。

en.t: In Boston, Massachusetts, the American Statistical Association is founded
en.s: The American Statistical Association (ASA) is the main professional organization for statisticians and related professionals in the United States. It was founded in Boston, Massachusetts, on November 27, 1839, and is the second-oldest continuously operating professional society in the U.S. behind the Massachusetts Medical Society (founded in 1781). ASA services statisticians, quantitative scientists, and users of statistics across many academic areas and applications.

zh.t: 美国统计学会在马萨诸塞州波士顿成立
zh.s: 美国统计学会（ASA）是美国统计学家及相关专业人士的主要专业组织。该会于1839年11月27日在马萨诸塞州波士顿成立，是美国历史第二悠久且持续运作的专业学会，仅次于1781年成立的马萨诸塞州医学会。ASA为许多学术领域和应用领域的统计学家、定量科学家及统计学使用者提供服务。

en.s: The Bombardment of Salé was a French naval attack against the Moroccan city of Salé that took place between 26 and 27 November 1851. After seven hours of fighting, the Moroccan artillery suffered severe damage, and the French bombarded the city through the night, damaging the city's infrastructure and the Great Mosque of Salé.

zh.s: 1851年11月26日至27日，法国海军袭击摩洛哥城市萨累。战斗持续7小时后，摩洛哥炮兵遭到严重破坏。法国海军连夜轰击该城，损坏了城市基础设施和萨累大清真寺。

en.s: The Battle of Gur Amba was fought on 27 November 1852 between the forces of the Ethiopian regent, Ras Ali II, and the rebel forces of Kassa Hailu. Kassa was victorious, and Goshu Zewde of Mota, Gojjam, the commander of the regent's forces, was killed. This was the first of a series of four victories which led to Kassa becoming Emperor Tewodros II of Ethiopia.

zh.s: 1852年11月27日，埃塞俄比亚摄政王拉斯·阿里二世的部队与卡萨·海卢领导的叛军交战。卡萨获胜，摄政王军队指挥官戈舒·泽伍德在战斗中阵亡。此后，卡萨又连胜三场，最终成为埃塞俄比亚皇帝特沃德罗斯二世。

en.s: The Luxembourg coup of 1856, also called the putsch of 1856, was a reactionary revision of Luxembourg's constitution on 27 November 1856. Whilst not a true coup d'état or revolution, its detractors dubbed it a "royal coup", as the reigning Grand Duke of Luxembourg, William III, greatly expanded his powers, and the name has stuck.

zh.s: 1856年11月27日，卢森堡修订宪法，强化保守王权。这一事件也称1856年政变。虽然它并非真正的政变或革命，但批评者称之为“王室政变”；当时的卢森堡大公威廉三世大幅扩大了自己的权力，这一称呼由此沿用下来。

en.s: The siege of Lucknow was the prolonged defence of the British Residency within the city of Lucknow from rebel sepoys (Indian soldiers in the British East India Company's Army) during the Indian Rebellion of 1857. After two successive relief attempts had reached the city, the defenders and civilians were evacuated from the Residency, which was then abandoned.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 勒克瑙围城战是1857年印度起义期间的一场长期防守战。叛军印度士兵围攻了英国东印度公司在勒克瑙市内的驻地。盟军两次成功抵达该城增援后，守军和市民从驻地撤离，随后该驻地被放弃。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Ringgold Gap was fought November 27, 1863, in northwest Georgia during the Chattanooga Campaign of the American Civil War. The Confederate victory by Maj. Gen. Patrick Cleburne gave the artillery and wagon trains of the Army of Tennessee safe passage to retreat through the "Ringgold Gap" mountain pass and caused high Federal casualties.

zh.s: 1863年11月27日，美国内战期间，乔治亚州西北部发生林戈尔德隘口战役。帕特里克·克莱本少将率领的邦联军获胜，使田纳西军团的炮兵和辎重车队得以安全穿过林戈尔德隘口撤退，并给联邦军造成重大伤亡。

en.s: The Battle of Mine Run, also known as Payne's Farm, or New Hope Church, or the Mine Run campaign (November 27 – December 2, 1863), was conducted in Orange County, Virginia, in the American Civil War. An unsuccessful attempt of the Union Army of the Potomac to defeat the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia, it was marked by false starts and low casualties and ended hostilities in the eastern theater for the year.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 米恩溪战役又称佩恩农场战役、新希望教堂战役或米恩溪战役行动，于1863年11月27日至12月2日在弗吉尼亚州奥兰治县进行，是美国内战的一部分。波托马克联邦军试图击败北弗吉尼亚邦联军，但没有成功。战役屡次因准备不足而未能推进，双方伤亡较少，并使东部战区当年暂停交战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of the Washita River (also called Battle of the Washita or the Washita Massacre) occurred on November 27, 1868, when Lt. Col. George Armstrong Custer's 7th U.S. Cavalry attacked Black Kettle's Southern Cheyenne camp on the Washita River (the present-day Washita Battlefield National Historic Site near Cheyenne, Oklahoma). The Cheyenne camp was the most isolated band of a major winter encampment along the river of numerous Native American tribal bands, totaling thousands of people.

zh.s: 瓦希塔河战役又称瓦希塔战役或瓦希塔大屠杀，发生于1868年11月27日。当时乔治·阿姆斯特朗·卡斯特中校率领美国第七骑兵团，袭击了黑水壶领导的南夏延人营地。营地位于瓦希塔河畔，是沿河一处大型冬季营地中最偏远的部落营地；这片冬季营地聚集了数千名美洲原住民。地点靠近今俄克拉何马州夏延附近的瓦希塔战场国家历史遗址。

en.s: The Battle of Amiens or Battle of Villers-Bretonneux was fought on 27 November 1870 during the Franco-Prussian War, ending in a Prussian victory. The French under General Jean-Joseph Farre fought the Prussians under Edwin Freiherr von Manteuffel in Amiens, France. Having already capitulated at Metz, the French were compelled to leave the city of Amiens. About 1,383 French soldiers were killed and wounded, and about 1,000 were declared to be missing.

zh.s: 亚眠战役又称维莱-布勒托讷战役，于1870年11月27日普法战争期间发生，以普鲁士获胜告终。让-约瑟夫·法尔将军率领的法军在法国亚眠与埃德温·冯·曼托伊费尔男爵率领的普军交战。法国军队此前已在梅斯投降，因此被迫撤出亚眠。约1,383名法军士兵阵亡或受伤，另有约1,000人被列为失踪。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on 20 November 1870, with a second round of voting on 27 November. They were a snap election, called by Prime Minister Giovanni Lanza to take advantage by the Capture of Rome and to give parliamentary representation to the future capital of Italy. Only 530,018 men of a total population of around 26 million were entitled to vote.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1870年11月20日，意大利举行大选，11月27日进行第二轮投票。总理乔瓦尼·兰扎提前举行选举，目的是利用攻占罗马的局势，让意大利未来首都获得议会代表席位。意大利约2,600万人口中，只有530,018名男性有投票资格。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: The Christchurch mayoral election held on 27 November 1878 was contested by the incumbent mayor, Henry Thomson, and senior Christchurch City Councillor Charles Thomas Ick. The election was won by Ick with a large margin.

zh.s: 1878年11月27日举行的基督城市长选举由现任市长亨利·汤姆森和资深市议员查尔斯·托马斯·艾克角逐。艾克以较大优势胜出。

en.s: The 1878 Wellington mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year to decide who would take the office of Mayor of Wellington.

zh.s: 1878年惠灵顿市长选举是当年新西兰地方选举的一部分，用于选出惠灵顿市长。

en.s: The Battle of Tarapacá occurred on November 27, 1879, during the Tarapacá Campaign of the War of the Pacific. A Chilean column of 2,300 soldiers led by General Luis Arteaga recklessly attacked an outnumbering Peruvian contingent of 4,500 troops at Tarapacá commanded by Gen Juan Buendía, resulting in a harsh defeat. The Chilean 2nd Line Regiment was the most damaged unit, losing almost half of its force, along with its commander Col. Eleuterio Ramírez and his second in command, Lt. Col. Bartolomé Vivar. Also, the unit lost its banner, which was recovered six months later after the battle of Tacna.

zh.s: 塔拉帕卡战役于1879年11月27日发生，是太平洋战争中塔拉帕卡战役行动的一部分。路易斯·阿尔特阿加将军率领2,300名智利士兵，贸然进攻胡安·布恩迪亚将军指挥的4,500名秘鲁军队，结果惨败。智利第二线团损失最重，几乎折损一半兵力；团长埃莱乌特里奥·拉米雷斯上校和副团长巴托洛梅·比瓦尔中校也阵亡。该团还丢失了团旗，后来在六个月后的塔克纳战役后被找回。

en.s: The Battle of Pirot (Bulgarian: Битка при Пирот Serbian: Битка код Пирота) took place between 26 and 27 November 1885[a], during the Serbo-Bulgarian War, near the town of Pirot, Serbia. The battle opposed the Bulgaria Western Corps to the Serbian Nišava Army. It ended with a Bulgarian victory and the signing of an armistice. The battle led to the treaty of Bucharest ending the Serbo-Bulgarian War, restoring peace between the two countries.

zh.s: 皮罗特战役发生于1885年11月26日至27日塞保战争期间，地点在塞尔维亚皮罗特附近。交战双方是保加利亚西部军团和塞尔维亚尼沙瓦军团。战斗以保加利亚获胜并签署停战协定告终，随后两国签订《布加勒斯特条约》，结束塞保战争并恢复和平。

en.s: The 1889 Invercargill mayoral election was held on 27 November 1889. Former mayor John Walker Mitchell defeated James Mackintosh.

zh.s: 1889年11月27日举行的因弗卡吉尔市长选举中，前市长约翰·沃克·米切尔击败詹姆斯·麦金托什。

en.s: The 1889 Wellington mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year to decide who would take the office of Mayor of Wellington for the following year.

zh.s: 1889年惠灵顿市长选举是当年新西兰地方选举的一部分，用于选出下一任惠灵顿市长。

en.s: The Christchurch mayoral election held on 27 November 1895 was contested by city councillors Howell Widdowson and Harry Beswick. Both candidates were young solicitors with few prior civic roles. Initially, the incumbent mayor—Walter Cooper—was one of the candidates but he withdrew. Widdowson attracted some controversy over the question whether he put his nomination forward ahead of a more senior city councillor; many voters still expected at the time that a mayoralty should be assigned to the most senior councillor.

zh.s: 1895年11月27日举行的基督城市长选举由市议员豪厄尔·威德森和哈里·贝斯威克角逐。两名候选人都很年轻，都是事务律师，此前担任公职的经历不多。现任市长沃尔特·库珀最初也是候选人，但后来退出。威德森因提名时间是否早于一位资历更深的市议员而引发争议；当时不少选民仍认为，市长职位应由资历最深的市议员担任。

en.s: The 1895 Invercargill mayoral election was held on 27 November 1895 as part of that year's local elections. John Sinclair defeated former mayor John Walker Mitchell.

zh.s: 1895年11月27日举行的因弗卡吉尔市长选举是当年地方选举的一部分。约翰·辛克莱击败前市长约翰·沃克·米切尔。

en.s: The 1895 Wellington mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method.

zh.s: 1895年惠灵顿市长选举是当年新西兰地方选举的一部分，投票采用得票最多者当选制。

en.t: Alfred Nobel signs his final will in Paris
en.s: On November 27, 1895, Alfred Nobel signed his final will at the Swedish–Norwegian Club in Paris. He directed that most of his estate be used to fund annual prizes in physics, chemistry, physiology or medicine, literature and peace. The Nobel Prizes were established after his death the following year.
en.n: This is the signing of Nobel's will, not the first award of the prizes in 1901.

zh.t: 阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔在巴黎签署最后一份遗嘱
zh.s: 1895年11月27日，阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔在巴黎的瑞典－挪威俱乐部签署最后一份遗嘱。他决定将大部分遗产用于设立物理、化学、生理学或医学、文学和和平奖。诺贝尔奖在他次年去世后才得以设立。
zh.n: 这一天签署的是诺贝尔遗嘱，首届诺贝尔奖颁于1901年。

en.t: The US Army establishes its War College by General Order 155
en.s: On November 27, 1901, the US War Department issued General Order 155, formally establishing the Army War College for advanced study by Army officers. Its original site was Washington Barracks in Washington, DC. The college moved to Carlisle Barracks, Pennsylvania, decades later.
en.n: The 1901 order established the college; its present Carlisle campus came later.

zh.t: 美国陆军依据第155号总令设立陆军战争学院
zh.s: 1901年11月27日，美国陆军部发布第155号总令，正式设立陆军战争学院，为军官提供高级课程。学院最初设在华盛顿的军营，几十年后才迁往宾夕法尼亚州的卡莱尔军营。
zh.n: 1901年的命令设立了学院；如今所在的卡莱尔校区是后来才启用的。

en.s: National Assembly elections were held in Montenegro on 27 November 1905. They were the first elections in the country's history, and were called to elect a National Assembly that would approve a constitution.

zh.s: 1905年11月27日，黑山举行国民议会选举。这是该国历史上首次选举，目的是选出国民议会并批准宪法。

en.s: The Battle of Yangxia (simplified Chinese: 阳夏之战; traditional Chinese: 陽夏之戰), also known as the Defense of Yangxia (simplified Chinese: 阳夏保卫战; traditional Chinese: 陽夏保衛戰), was the largest military engagement of the Xinhai Revolution and was fought from October 18 to November 27, 1911, between the revolutionaries of the Wuchang Uprising and the loyalist armies of the Qing dynasty.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 阳夏之战又称阳夏保卫战，是辛亥革命期间规模最大的一场军事交战，于1911年10月18日至11月27日发生，交战双方为武昌起义军和清朝军队。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Merhamli was part of the First Balkan War between the armies of Bulgaria and the Ottoman Empire which took place on 14/27 November 1912. After a long chase throughout Western Thrace the Bulgarian troops led by General Nikola Genev and Colonel Aleksandar Tanev surrounded the 10,000-strong the Kırcaali Detachment under the command of Mehmed Yaver Pasha. Attacked in the surrounding of the village Merhamli (Now Peplos in modern Greece), only a few of the Ottomans managed to cross the Maritsa River. The rest surrendered in the following day on 28 November.

zh.s: 梅尔哈姆利战役是第一次巴尔干战争的一部分，于1912年11月14日（旧历）/27日发生。尼古拉·热涅夫将军和亚历山大·塔涅夫上校率领的保加利亚军队在西色雷斯长途追击后，包围了由穆罕默德·亚韦尔帕夏指挥的奥斯曼军队克尔贾利支队，兵力约一万人。保加利亚军队在梅尔哈姆利村（今希腊佩普洛斯）附近发动进攻，只有少数奥斯曼士兵成功渡过马里查河，其余人员于次日11月28日投降。

en.s: The Battle of the Olt Valley consisted in a prolonged military engagement during World War I between Romanian forces on one side and Central Powers' forces (Germany and Austria-Hungary) on the other side. Within just under a month, the Central Powers had managed to conquer the 30 miles (48 km)-long Olt Valley from its Romanian defenders.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 奥尔特河谷战役是第一次世界大战期间的一场长期军事交战，罗马尼亚军队与德国和奥匈帝国组成的同盟国军队交战。不到一个月内，同盟国军队从罗马尼亚守军手中夺取了长48公里的奥尔特河谷。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Slatina was a military engagement between Romanian and German forces during World War I. It resulted in a strategic victory for the Romanians.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，罗马尼亚军队与德国军队在斯拉蒂纳交战。战斗以罗马尼亚取得战略胜利告终。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Svinhufvud's Senate begins work in Finland
en.s: On November 27, 1917, Finland's parliament approved a new Senate led by Pehr Evind Svinhufvud, and it began work that day. The Senate would present Finland's declaration of independence to parliament on December 4; parliament approved the declaration on December 6. The appointment was a step toward independence, not the declaration itself.
en.n: The Senate began on November 27; Finland's declaration was presented December 4 and approved December 6.

zh.t: 斯温胡武德领导的芬兰参议院开始工作
zh.s: 1917年11月27日，芬兰议会批准由佩尔·埃温德·斯温胡武德领导的新参议院，参议院当天开始工作。它于12月4日向议会提交独立宣言，议会在12月6日通过。11月27日是独立进程中的一步，并非宣布独立的日期。
zh.n: 参议院于11月27日开始工作；独立宣言于12月4日提交、12月6日通过。

en.s: The Treaty of Neuilly-sur-Seine (French: Traité de Neuilly-sur-Seine; Bulgarian: Ньойски договор, romanized: Noĭski dogovor) was a treaty between the victorious Allies of World War I on the one hand, and Bulgaria, one of the defeated Central Powers in World War I, on the other. The treaty required Bulgaria to cede various territories. The treaty was signed on 27 November 1919, in Neuilly-sur-Seine in the Hauts-de-Seine department, just west of Paris in France.

zh.s: 《讷伊—塞纳条约》（法语：Traité de Neuilly-sur-Seine；保加利亚语：Ньойски договор，转写：Noĭski dogovor）由第一次世界大战的战胜国协约国与战败的同盟国成员保加利亚签订。条约要求保加利亚割让多个地区。条约于1919年11月27日在法国上塞纳省讷伊—塞纳签署，该地位于巴黎以西。

en.s: The Urtatagai conflict was a conflict between the Soviet Union and the Emirate of Afghanistan in the mid-1920s over the control of the island of Urta Tagay, which is an island on the Amu Darya river that had been claimed by Afghanistan since 1900, although it was under Russian control until 1920, when remnants of the Imperial Russian Army evacuated the island to aid the White movement in the Russian Civil War.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 乌尔塔塔盖冲突是苏联与阿富汗埃米尔国在20世纪20年代中期围绕乌尔塔塔盖岛控制权发生的争端。该岛位于阿姆河上，自1900年起被阿富汗主张拥有，但直到1920年仍由俄罗斯控制；当年俄罗斯帝国军队残部撤离该岛，转而支援俄国内战中的白军运动。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: Atlético v Cruzeiro (1927) was a state football game played on 27 November 1927. It was the largest win in the history of the Clássico Mineiro, the derby between the 2 biggest clubs of Minas Gerais.

zh.t: 米内罗竞技9比2击败克鲁塞罗（1927年）
zh.s: 1927年11月27日，米内罗竞技对阵克鲁塞罗，进行了一场州级足球赛。这是米纳斯吉拉斯州两家最大俱乐部之间的米内罗德比史上分差最大的一场比赛。

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 27 November 1932.The Catholic Party won 79 of the 187 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 42 of the 93 seats in the Senate. Voter turnout was 94.3%.

zh.s: 1932年11月27日，比利时举行大选。天主教党在众议院187个席位中赢得79席，在参议院93个席位中赢得42席。投票率为94.3%。

en.s: The 1934 Bolivian coup d'état, colloquially known as the Corralito of Villamontes (Spanish: Corralito de Villamontes), was a military coup in Bolivia that deposed President Daniel Salamanca in the midst of the Chaco War. Two days before the coup, Salamanca and his presidential delegation arrived at the military headquarters in Villamontes with the intent of removing General Enrique Peñaranda as commander-in-chief of the armed forces and replacing him with General José Leonardo Lanza. In response, on 27 November 1934, army high command directed a group of military officers led by Captain Germán Busch to arrest the president and force his resignation.

zh.s: 1934年玻利维亚政变又俗称“比利亚蒙特斯兵变”，发生在查科战争期间，推翻了总统丹尼尔·萨拉曼卡。政变前两天，萨拉曼卡和总统代表团抵达比利亚蒙特斯军方总部，打算撤换武装部队总司令恩里克·佩尼亚兰达将军，改由何塞·莱昂纳多·兰萨将军接任。1934年11月27日，陆军最高指挥部命令德国·布什上尉率领一队军官逮捕总统并迫使他辞职。

en.s: The Brazilian communist uprising (Portuguese: Intentona Comunista) was a military revolt in Brazil led by Luís Carlos Prestes and leftist low-rank military against Getúlio Vargas's government on behalf of the National Liberation Alliance (Aliança Nacional Libertadora - ANL). It took place in the cities of Natal, Recife, and the capital Rio de Janeiro between 23 and 27 November 1935.

zh.s: 巴西共产主义起义（葡萄牙语：Intentona Comunista）是巴西的一场军事叛乱，由路易斯·卡洛斯·普雷斯特斯和左翼基层军人领导，代表民族解放联盟反对热图利奥·瓦加斯政府。起义于1935年11月23日至27日在纳塔尔、累西腓和首都里约热内卢发生。

en.s: The Battle of Cape Spartivento, known as the Battle of Cape Teulada in Italy, was a naval battle during the Battle of the Mediterranean in the Second World War. It was fought between naval forces of the British Royal Navy and the Italian Regia Marina on 27 November 1940.

zh.s: 斯巴蒂文托角海战在意大利称为特乌拉达角海战，是第二次世界大战地中海战役期间的一场海战，于1940年11月27日发生，交战双方为英国皇家海军和意大利皇家海军。

en.t: In Romania, the ruling Iron Guard fascist party assassinates over 60 of arrested King Carol II of Romania's aides and other political dissidents
en.s: The Iron Guard (Romanian: Garda de Fier) was a far-right, revolutionary, fascist paramilitary organization and political party active in the Kingdom of Romania during the interwar period and the Second World War. Founded in 1927 by Corneliu Zelea Codreanu as the Legion of the Archangel Michael (Legiunea Arhanghelul Mihail) or the Legionary Movement (Mișcarea Legionară), the movement was strongly anti-democratic, anti-communist, and antisemitic, and its ideology inspired both political violence and forms of Christian terrorism.

zh.t: 罗马尼亚执政法西斯铁卫团杀害了被捕的卡罗尔二世国王60多名亲信及其他政治异见人士
zh.s: 铁卫团（罗马尼亚语：Garda de Fier）是一个极右翼革命性法西斯准军事组织和政党，在两次世界大战之间及第二次世界大战期间活跃于罗马尼亚王国。该运动由科尔内留·泽莱亚·科德雷亚努于1927年创立，最初称为米哈伊尔天使军团（Legiunea Arhanghelul Mihail）或军团运动（Mișcarea Legionară）。该运动强烈反民主、反共、反犹，其意识形态既助长政治暴力，也催生了某些形式的基督教恐怖主义。

en.s: The siege of Tobruk () took place between 10 April and 27 November 1941, during the Western Desert campaign (1940–1943) of the Second World War. An Allied force, consisting mostly of the 9th Australian Division, commanded by Lieutenant-General Leslie Morshead, was besieged in the North African port of Tobruk by German and Italian forces. The tenacious defenders quickly became known as the Rats of Tobruk.

zh.s: 托布鲁克围城战发生于1941年4月10日至11月27日，是第二次世界大战西部沙漠战役的一部分。盟军部队主要由澳大利亚第九师组成，由莱斯利·莫斯黑德中将指挥，被德意联军围困在北非港口托布鲁克。坚守阵地的守军很快被称为“托布鲁克之鼠”。

en.s: The Battle of Gondar or Capture of Gondar was the last stand of the Italian forces in Italian East Africa during the Second World War. The battle took place in November 1941, during the East African Campaign. Gondar was the main town of Amhara in the mountains north of Lake Tana in Ethiopia, at an elevation of 7,000 ft (2,100 m) and had an Italian garrison of 40,000 men, commanded by Generale Guglielmo Nasi.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 贡达尔战役又称贡达尔陷落，是第二次世界大战期间意属东非意大利军队的最后一战。战斗于1941年11月在东非战役期间发生。贡达尔是阿姆哈拉地区的主要城镇，位于埃塞俄比亚塔纳湖以北的山区，海拔7,000英尺（2,100米），驻有4万名意大利士兵，由古列尔莫·纳西将军指挥。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Italian guerrilla war in Ethiopia was a conflict fought from the summer of 1941 to the autumn of 1943 by remnants of Italian troops in Ethiopia and Somalia, in a short-lived attempt to re-establish Italian East Africa. The guerrilla campaign was fought following the Italian defeat in the East African campaign of the Second World War, while the war continued in Northern Africa and Europe.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 意大利在埃塞俄比亚的游击战争
zh.s: 意大利在埃塞俄比亚的游击战争是1941年夏至1943年秋之间的一场冲突，由埃塞俄比亚和索马里的意大利军队残部发动，试图短暂恢复意属东非。第二次世界大战东非战役中意大利战败后，游击战随之展开；当时北非和欧洲的战争仍在继续。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Scuttling of the French fleet at Toulon
en.s: The scuttling of the French fleet at Toulon was orchestrated by Vichy France on 27 November 1942 to prevent Nazi German forces from seizing it. After the Allied invasion of North Africa, the Germans invaded the territory administered by Vichy under the Armistice of 1940. The Vichy Secretary of the Navy, Admiral François Darlan, defected to the Allies, who were gaining increasing support from servicemen and civilians.

zh.t: 土伦法国舰队自沉事件
zh.s: 1942年11月27日，维希法国下令土伦法国舰队自沉，以防纳粹德国夺取舰队。盟军入侵北非后，德国军队进入由维希政府根据1940年停战协定管辖的地区。维希政府海军部长弗朗索瓦·达尔朗海军上将转投盟军阵营，当时越来越多军人和平民支持盟军。

en.s: Case Anton (German: Unternehmen Anton) was the military occupation of Vichy France carried out by Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy in November 1942. It marked the end of the Vichy regime as a nominally independent state and the disbanding of its army (the severely-limited Armistice Army), but it continued its existence as a puppet government within Occupied France.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 安东行动（德语：Unternehmen Anton）是纳粹德国和法西斯意大利于1942年11月对维希法国实施的军事占领。这标志着名义上独立的维希政权结束，其军队（规模受到严格限制的停战军）也被解散。不过，维希政府作为傀儡政权，仍在被占领的法国境内继续存在。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The RAF Fauld explosion occurred during the Second World War at the RAF Fauld underground munitions storage depot in Staffordshire, England at 11:11 am on Monday, 27 November 1944. The blast, which was one of the largest non-nuclear explosions in history, detonated between 3,500 and 4,000 tonnes (3,900 and 4,400 tons) of high explosive military ordnance.

zh.t: 英国皇家空军福尔德军火库爆炸
zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，英国皇家空军斯塔福德郡福尔德地下军火库于1944年11月27日星期一上午11时11分发生爆炸。爆炸引爆了3,500至4,000吨（3,900至4,400美吨）高爆炸药，是历史上规模最大的非核爆炸之一。

en.s: The Battle of Peleliu, codenamed Operation Stalemate II by the US military, was fought between the United States and Japan during the Mariana and Palau Islands campaign of World War II, from 15 September to 27 November 1944, on the island of Peleliu. US marines of the 1st Marine Division and then soldiers of the US Army's 81st Infantry Division fought to capture an airfield on the small coral island of Peleliu.

zh.s: 佩莱利乌战役在美军代号为“僵局二号行动”，是第二次世界大战马里亚纳群岛和帕劳群岛战役的一部分，于1944年9月15日至11月27日在佩莱利乌岛发生。美国海军陆战队第一师和随后赶到的陆军第81步兵师试图夺取这座珊瑚小岛上的机场。

en.t: Twenty-two US organizations found CARE in New York City
en.s: On November 27, 1945, twenty-two American civic, relief and charitable organizations launched the group that became CARE in New York City. Initially called the Cooperative for American Remittances to Europe, it organized aid packages for people in Europe after World War II. The first packages arrived in 1946.
en.n: This is the organization's founding; its first aid packages reached Europe the following year.

zh.s: 1945年11月27日，22家美国民间和慈善机构在纽约成立救援组织，后来发展为CARE。它的初衷是向二战后的欧洲民众寄送救援包裹，首批包裹在1946年送达。
zh.n: 这一天是机构成立日，首批救援包裹次年才送达欧洲。

en.s: The 1946 Combined Scottish Universities by-election was a by-election held from 22 to 27 November 1946 for the Combined Scottish Universities, a university constituency of the British House of Commons. It was the last election for a university constituency of the UK Parliament; the Combined Scottish Universities was abolished along with the other university seats for the 1950 general election.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1946年苏格兰大学联合选区补选
zh.s: 1946年11月22日至27日，英国下议院苏格兰大学联合选区举行补选。这是英国议会大学选区的最后一次选举；1950年大选前，苏格兰大学联合选区与其他大学选区一并废除。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Colombia on 27 November 1949. The result was a victory for Laureano Gómez of the Conservative Party, who received all but 23 of the 1.1 million valid votes cast. The opposition Liberal Party withdrew from the election and called for a boycott after their candidate Darío Echandía was the victim of a failed assassination attempt.

zh.s: 1949年11月27日，哥伦比亚举行总统选举。保守党候选人劳雷亚诺·戈麦斯获胜，在投出的110万张有效选票中，只有23票没有投给他。反对党自由党候选人达里奥·埃昌迪亚曾遭遇暗杀未遂，自由党随后退出选举并呼吁抵制。

en.s: The Bobai campaign (博白战役) was a campaign fought between the nationalists and the communists during the Chinese Civil War in the post-World War II era and resulted in communist victory. The campaign was part of Guangxi campaign. Order of battle Nationalists: III Corps 7th Army 48th Army 126th Army Communists: 43rd Army 14th Army 15th Army After the nationalist offensive in the southern front had been defeated by the advance communist, Bai Chongxi ordered the nationalist III Corps and XI Corps to immediately retreat.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 博白战役（博白战役）是第二次世界大战后中国内战期间国民党与共产党之间的一场战役，以共产党获胜告终。该战役是广西战役的一部分。双方参战序列如下：国民党方面有第三军、第七军、第四十八军和第一二六军；共产党方面有第四十三军、第十四军和第十五军。国民党军南线进攻被共产党军推进击败后，白崇禧命令国民党第三军和第十一军立即撤退。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Chosin Reservoir, also known as the Chosin Reservoir Campaign or the Battle of Lake Changjin (Korean: 장진호 전투; Hanja: 長津湖戰鬪; MR: Changjinho chŏnt'u), was a battle in the Korean War. The name "Chosin" is derived from the Japanese pronunciation "Chōshin", instead of the Korean pronunciation.

zh.s: 长津湖战役是朝鲜战争中的一场战役，也称“Chosin Reservoir Campaign”或“Battle of Lake Changjin”。“Chosin”一名来自日语读音“Chōshin”，而不是韩语读音。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Czechoslovakia on 26 and 27 November 1971. They were the first held after the Constitutional Act on the Czechoslovak Federation converted Czechoslovakia into a federal republic, comprising the Czech Socialist Republic and the Slovak Socialist Republic, as well as the first elections in Czechoslovakia held in the aftermath of the Prague Spring.

zh.s: 1971年11月26日至27日，捷克斯洛伐克举行议会选举。这是《捷克斯洛伐克联邦宪法法案》将捷克斯洛伐克改为联邦共和国后首次举行的选举，国家由捷克社会主义共和国和斯洛伐克社会主义共和国组成。这也是布拉格之春之后该国举行的首次选举。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the Slovak Socialist Republic on 26 and 27 November 1971 alongside national elections. All 150 seats in the National Council were won by the National Front.

zh.s: 1971年11月26日至27日，斯洛伐克社会主义共和国举行议会选举，同时举行全国选举。国民阵线赢得国民议会全部150个席位。

en.s: National Council elections were held in the Czech part of Czechoslovakia on 26 and 27 November 1971. They were the first direct elections after the creation of the Czech National Council, whose first members were co-opted in 1968 by the members of National Assembly, elected in 1964.

zh.s: 1971年11月26日至27日，捷克斯洛伐克境内的捷克地区举行民族委员会选举。这是捷克民族委员会成立后的首次直接选举。该委员会首批成员于1968年由1964年选出的国民议会成员推选产生。

en.t: The Provisional IRA assassinates Ross McWhirter, after a press conference in which McWhirter had announced a reward for the capture of those responsible for multiple bombings and shootings across England
en.s: Alan Ross McWhirter (12 August 1925 – 27 November 1975) was, with his twin brother, Norris, the cofounder of the 1955 Guinness Book of Records (known since 2000 as Guinness World Records) and a contributor to the television programme Record Breakers. He was assassinated by the Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) in 1975.

zh.t: 临时爱尔兰共和军刺杀罗斯·麦克沃特
zh.s: 罗斯·麦克沃特与双胞胎兄弟诺里斯共同创办1955年《吉尼斯世界纪录大全》（现称《吉尼斯世界纪录》），并为电视节目《纪录破纪录者》撰稿。1975年，他遭临时爱尔兰共和军刺杀。

en.t: 1977 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship final
en.s: The 1977 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship final was the fourth All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1977 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship, an inter-county ladies' Gaelic football tournament for the top teams in Ireland. Cavan won by two goals – much media attention was focused on their midfielder Pauline Gibbons, who left the team mid-season to become an Augustinian nun, and received special permission from the Mother Superior to return for the final.

zh.t: 1977年全爱尔兰女子高级足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1977年全爱尔兰女子高级足球锦标赛决赛是该赛事第4届决赛，也是决定当届冠军的比赛。爱尔兰各郡女子盖尔式足球顶尖队伍参加了这项赛事。卡文队以两球优势获胜。媒体特别关注该队中场波琳·吉本斯，她在赛季中途离队成为奥古斯丁会修女，并在院长特别许可下回队参加决赛。

en.s: From 1978 until 2025, the Republic of Turkey was in an armed conflict with the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) (Kurdish: Partiya Karkerên Kurdistanê) as well as its allied insurgent groups, both Kurdish and non-Kurdish. The initial core demand of the PKK was its separation from Turkey to create an independent Kurdistan. In 2010, the PKK abandoned separatism in favor of autonomy and/or greater political and cultural rights for Kurds inside the Republic of Turkey.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1978年至2025年，土耳其共和国与库尔德工人党（PKK；库尔德语：Partiya Karkerên Kurdistanê）及其库尔德和非库尔德盟友武装组织发生武装冲突。库尔德工人党最初的核心诉求是脱离土耳其、建立独立的库尔德斯坦。2010年，该党放弃分离主义，转而要求自治，和／或在土耳其共和国境内为库尔德人争取更多政治和文化权利。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: George Moscone and Harvey Milk are assassinated at San Francisco City Hall
en.s: On November 27, 1978, former city supervisor Dan White shot and killed San Francisco Mayor George Moscone and supervisor Harvey Milk inside City Hall. White first killed Moscone, then went to Milk's office and killed him. Their deaths shocked the city and prompted public mourning.
en.n: Both assassinations occurred on the same day at San Francisco City Hall.

zh.t: 旧金山市长莫斯科尼和市议员米尔克遇刺
zh.s: 1978年11月27日，旧金山前市议员丹·怀特在市政厅枪杀了市长乔治·莫斯科尼，又到市议员哈维·米尔克的办公室将他杀害。两人同日遇刺，旧金山各界随后举行悼念活动。
zh.n: 两起枪杀都发生在同一天的旧金山市政厅。

en.t: The Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) is founded in the Turkish village of Fis
en.s: The Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) is a Kurdish militant political organization and armed guerrilla group primarily based in the mountainous Kurdish-majority regions of southeastern Turkey, northern Iraq and north-eastern Syria. It was founded in Ziyaret, Lice, on 27 November 1978 and was involved in asymmetric warfare in the Kurdistan Workers' Party insurgency (with several ceasefires between 1993 and 2013–2015).

zh.t: 库尔德工人党在土耳其菲斯村成立
zh.s: 库尔德工人党（PKK）是一个库尔德武装政治组织和游击队，主要活动于土耳其东南部、伊拉克北部和叙利亚东北部的库尔德人聚居山区。该组织于1978年11月27日在迪亚巴克尔省利杰区的济亚雷特成立，之后参与了库尔德工人党叛乱；期间曾多次停火。

en.s: Avianca Flight 011 was a Boeing 747-200BM Combi on an international scheduled passenger flight from Frankfurt to Bogotá via Paris, Madrid, and Caracas that crashed near Madrid on 27 November 1983. It took off from Charles de Gaulle Airport in Paris at 22:25 on 26 November 1983 for Madrid Barajas Airport; take-off was delayed waiting for additional passengers from a Lufthansa flight due to a cancellation of the Paris-Frankfurt-Paris segment by Avianca for operational reasons.

zh.t: 阿维安卡航空011号班机空难
zh.s: 1983年11月27日，阿维安卡航空011号班机在马德里附近坠毁。这架波音747-200BM客货混合型客机执行从法兰克福飞往波哥大的定期国际航班，中途经停巴黎、马德里和加拉加斯。飞机于1983年11月26日22时25分从巴黎戴高乐机场起飞，前往马德里巴拉哈斯机场。由于阿维安卡出于运营原因取消巴黎—法兰克福—巴黎航段，飞机等待搭乘汉莎航空航班、行程因此受影响的额外乘客，导致起飞延误。

en.s: Indirect parliamentary elections were held in Cuba on 27 November 1986. On 19 and 26 October voters elected members of the 169 Municipal Assemblies. A total of 6,704,479 votes were cast in the first round (19 October), a turnout of 97.65%. In the second round (26 October) turnout was 93.4%. The elected members of the Municipal Assemblies then elected the 510 members of the National Assembly.

zh.s: 1986年11月27日，古巴举行间接议会选举。此前，选民于10月19日和26日选出169个市级议会的成员。首轮投票于10月19日举行，共投出6,704,479张选票，投票率为97.65%；第二轮于10月26日举行，投票率为93.4%。随后，市级议会当选成员选出了510名全国议会代表。

en.s: Starrcade '86: The Skywalkers, also referred to as Starrcade '86: Night of The Skywalkers, was the fourth annual Starrcade professional wrestling closed-circuit television event produced by Jim Crockett Promotions (JCP) under the National Wrestling Alliance (NWA) banner. It took place on November 27, 1986, from the Greensboro Coliseum Complex in Greensboro, North Carolina and the Omni Coliseum in Atlanta, Georgia.

zh.s: Starrcade '86：天空行者又称Starrcade '86：天空行者之夜，是吉姆·克罗克特推广公司在国家摔角联盟旗下制作的第4届年度职业摔角闭路电视赛事。赛事于1986年11月27日在北卡罗来纳州格林斯伯勒的格林斯伯勒体育馆综合场馆和乔治亚州亚特兰大的奥姆尼体育馆举行。

en.s: Avianca Flight 203 was a Colombian domestic passenger flight from El Dorado International Airport in Bogotá to Alfonso Bonilla Aragón International Airport in Cali, Colombia of a Boeing 727. It was destroyed by a bomb over the municipality of Soacha on November 27, 1989. All 107 people on board as well as three people on the ground were killed. The bombing had been ordered by Medellín's drug cartel.

zh.t: 阿维安卡航空203号班机空难
zh.s: 1989年11月27日，阿维安卡航空203号班机在哥伦比亚境内执行国内客运航班，从波哥大的埃尔多拉多国际机场飞往卡利的阿方索·博尼利亚·阿拉贡国际机场。这架波音727客机在索阿查市上空被炸毁，机上107人和地面3人全部遇难。爆炸由麦德林贩毒集团下令实施。

en.s: The Deutschland-Cup was a one-off football competition played in November 1990, to celebrate German reunification. The match was played one week after the dissolution of the East German Football Association and its merger with the German Football Association, and featured the reigning champions of East and West Germany, Dynamo Dresden and Bayern Munich respectively. The match, which was played at the Rudolf-Harbig-Stadion in Dresden, was won 1–0 by Dynamo.

zh.s: 德国杯是一次性举行的足球比赛，1990年11月举办，以庆祝德国统一。比赛在东德足球协会解散并与德国足球协会合并一周后举行，由东德和西德的卫冕冠军德累斯顿迪纳摩和拜仁慕尼黑参赛。比赛在德累斯顿的鲁道夫·哈比希体育场举行，德累斯顿迪纳摩以1比0获胜。

en.s: The Insurgency in Assam refers to a series of multiple insurgent and separatist movements that had been operated in the Northeast Indian state of Assam. The conflict started in the 1970s following tension between the native indigenous Assamese people and the Indian government over alleged neglect, political, social, cultural, economic issues and increased levels of illegal immigration from Bangladesh.

zh.s: 阿萨姆邦叛乱指印度东北部阿萨姆邦发生的一系列叛乱和分离主义运动。冲突始于20世纪70年代，起因是当地阿萨姆原住民与印度政府之间的紧张关系，涉及被指忽视当地诉求、政治社会文化经济问题，以及来自孟加拉国的非法移民增加。

en.s: The 1991 Survivor Series was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the fifth annual Survivor Series and took place on Thanksgiving Eve in the United States on Wednesday, November 27, 1991, at the Joe Louis Arena in Detroit, Michigan; this was the first Survivor Series held on Thanksgiving Eve instead of the day of the holiday.

zh.s: 1991年幸存者系列大赛是世界摔角联盟（WWF，现为WWE）主办的职业摔角按次付费赛事，也是该系列第5届赛事。比赛于美国感恩节前夕，即1991年11月27日星期三，在密歇根州底特律的乔·路易斯体育馆举行。这是幸存者系列大赛首次在感恩节前夕举行，而非节日当天。

en.s: The Venezuelan coup attempt of November 1992 was an attempt to seize control of the government of Venezuela that took place on 27 November 1992. It was led by a group of young military officers who were loyal to the Hugo Chávez-led Revolutionary Bolivarian Movement-200 (MBR-200), while Chávez was in prison for the coup d'état attempt earlier that year.

zh.s: 1992年11月27日，委内瑞拉发生政变未遂，军方试图夺取政权。政变由一群年轻军官领导，他们效忠于乌戈·查韦斯领导的革命玻利瓦尔运动200；当时查韦斯因同年早些时候发动的政变未遂而身陷囹圄。

en.s: A general election was held in Honduras on 27 November 1993. Voters went to the polls to elect a new President of the Republic and a new Congress.

zh.s: 1993年11月27日，洪都拉斯举行大选，选民投票选出新一任总统和新一届国会。

en.s: The 1993 Ms. Olympia contest was an IFBB professional bodybuilding competition was held on November 27, 1993, at the Beacon Theatre in New York City, New York. It was the 14th Ms. Olympia competition held.

zh.s: 1993年奥林匹亚女士健美赛是国际健美联合会主办的职业健美比赛，于1993年11月27日在纽约市灯塔剧院举行。这是第14届奥林匹亚女士健美赛。

en.s: The 1994 Scottish League Cup final was played on 27 November 1994, at Ibrox Stadium in Glasgow, and was the final of the 49th Scottish League Cup competition. The final was contested by Raith Rovers and Celtic. Raith Rovers won the final on a penalty shootout after regular and extra time.

zh.s: 1994年苏格兰联赛杯决赛于1994年11月27日在格拉斯哥的伊布罗克斯球场举行，是第49届苏格兰联赛杯的决赛。决赛由拉夫流浪对阵凯尔特人。双方经过常规时间和加时赛后仍未分出胜负，拉夫流浪在点球大战中获胜。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Kiribati on 27 November 1998. The result was a victory for incumbent Teburoro Tito, who won 52.3% of the vote.

zh.s: 1998年11月27日，基里巴斯举行总统选举。现任总统塔布罗罗·蒂托获胜，得票率为52.3%。

en.s: Elections to the Madhya Pradesh Legislative Assembly were held in November 1998. The Indian National Congress won a majority of seats and Digvijaya Singh was sworn in as the new Chief Minister for the second time. These were the last elections to the legislative assembly before the passage of the Madhya Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2000, which carved out the new state of Chhattisgarh from Madhya Pradesh.

zh.s: 1998年11月，印度中央邦举行立法议会选举。印度国大党赢得多数席位，迪格维贾亚·辛格第二次宣誓就任邦首席部长。这是2000年《中央邦重组法案》通过前最后一次立法议会选举；该法案从中央邦划出恰蒂斯加尔邦。

en.s: The 1999 New Zealand general election was held on 27 November 1999 to determine the composition of the 46th New Zealand Parliament. The governing National Party, led by Prime Minister Jenny Shipley, was defeated, being replaced by a coalition of Helen Clark's Labour Party and the smaller Alliance. This marked an end to nine years of National Party government, and the beginning of the Fifth Labour Government of New Zealand which would govern for 9 years, until its loss to the National Party in the 2008 general election.

zh.s: 1999年11月27日，新西兰举行大选，选出第46届议会议员。由总理珍妮·希普利领导的执政国家党败选，海伦·克拉克领导的工党与小党联盟党组成联合政府。国家党由此结束连续9年的执政，工党第五届政府开始执政，并持续9年，直到在2008年大选中败给国家党。

en.s: The 2000 Canadian federal election was held on November 27, 2000, to elect 301 Members of Parliament of the Canadian House of Commons of the 37th Parliament of Canada. Since the previous election of 1997, small-"c" conservatives had begun attempts to merge the Reform Party of Canada and Progressive Conservative Party of Canada as part of the United Alternative agenda. During that time, Jean Charest stepped down as leader of the Progressive Conservatives and former Prime Minister Joe Clark took over the party and opposed any union with the Reform Party.

zh.s: 2000年11月27日，加拿大举行联邦大选，选出第37届加拿大国会下议院的301名议员。自1997年上次大选以来，小写字母c的保守派开始尝试合并加拿大改革党和进步保守党，这是“联合替代方案”的一部分。当时，进步保守党领袖让·克雷蒂安辞职，前总理乔·克拉克接任，并反对与改革党合并。

en.s: The 2001 Intercontinental Cup was an association football match played on 27 November 2001 between Bayern Munich, winners of the 2000–01 UEFA Champions League, and winners of the 2001 Copa Libertadores, Boca Juniors, which was also the defending champions. The match was played at the neutral venue of the National Stadium in Tokyo in front of 51,360 fans. Samuel Kuffour was named as man of the match.

zh.s: 2001年11月27日，拜仁慕尼黑对阵博卡青年，参加洲际杯足球赛。拜仁是2000—01赛季欧洲冠军联赛冠军，博卡青年则是2001年南美解放者杯冠军和卫冕球队。比赛在东京国立竞技场举行，共有51,360名观众到场。萨穆埃尔·库福尔获评全场最佳球员。

en.s: W.A.K.O. European Championships 2002 in Jesolo was the sixteenth European championships to be held by the W.A.K.O.. It was the second championships to be held in Jesolo and the seventh (including world championships) to be held in Italy. W.A.K.O. had originally hoped to have a joint event that year as they had with the last world championships, with an event in Greece in October and another in Hungary (and then Slovakia) in November but due to the difficulties involved scrapped the idea and resorted to Jesolo which had held a successful event two years previously.

zh.s: 2002年W.A.K.O.欧洲锦标赛在耶索洛举行，是该组织举办的第16届欧洲锦标赛。这是耶索洛第二次承办该项赛事，也是意大利第七次承办W.A.K.O.锦标赛（包括世界锦标赛）。

en.s: General elections were held in Grenada on 27 November 2003. The New National Party government of Prime Minister Keith Mitchell won a third consecutive term with a reduced majority. Voter turnout was 57.7%.

zh.s: 2003年11月27日，格林纳达举行大选。总理基思·米切尔领导的新国家党政府赢得第三个连续任期，但多数席位减少。投票率为57.7%。

en.s: Elections to the Madhya Pradesh Legislative Assembly were held on 27 November 2003. The Bharatiya Janata Party won a majority of seats and Uma Bharti was sworn in as the new Chief Minister.

zh.s: 2003年11月27日，印度中央邦举行立法议会选举。印度人民党赢得多数席位，乌玛·巴蒂宣誓就任新任首席部长。

en.s: Blackwater 61 was the callsign of a CASA 212 aircraft, registration N960BW, operated by Presidential Airways Inc, the aviation subsidiary of the private security contractor Blackwater USA, that crashed in the mountains of remote central Afghanistan on November 27, 2004. The turboprop airplane was carrying three military passengers and three members of the flight crew when it crashed into the highest of a range of mountains stretching west of Kabul.

zh.s: 黑水61是美国总统航空公司运营的CASA 212飞机的呼号，飞机注册编号为N960BW。该公司是私人安保承包商美国黑水公司的航空子公司。飞机于2004年11月27日在阿富汗中部偏远山区坠毁。事故发生时，机上载有3名军方乘客和3名机组人员。飞机撞上喀布尔以西一列山脉中最高的山峰。

en.s: Survivor Series (2005) was the 19th annual Survivor Series professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It took place on November 27, 2005, at the Joe Louis Arena in Detroit, Michigan and consisted of six professional wrestling matches involving wrestlers from the Raw and SmackDown brands. In the first of two main event matches, WWE Champion John Cena defeated Kurt Angle to retain his title. The second main event was an interpromotional 5-on-5 Survivor Series match, in which Team SmackDown (Batista, Rey Mysterio, John "Bradshaw" Layfield (JBL), Bobby Lashley, and Randy Orton) defeated Team Raw (Shawn Michaels, Kane, The Big Show, Carlito, and Chris Masters) after Orton last eliminated Michaels.

zh.s: 2005年幸存者系列大赛是世界摔角娱乐公司（WWE）主办的第19届年度按次付费职业摔角赛事，于2005年11月27日在密歇根州底特律的乔·路易斯体育馆举行，共有6场比赛，参赛者来自Raw和SmackDown两个品牌。两场主赛中的第一场由WWE冠军约翰·塞纳对阵科特·安格，塞纳获胜并保住冠军头衔。第二场主赛是Raw和SmackDown之间的5对5幸存者系列赛，SmackDown队由巴蒂斯塔、雷·密斯特里奥、约翰·“布拉德肖”·莱菲尔德（JBL）、鲍比·莱斯利和兰迪·奥顿组成，击败了由肖恩·迈克尔斯、凯恩、大秀哥、卡利托和克里斯·马斯特斯组成的Raw队。奥顿最后淘汰迈克尔斯。

en.s: General elections were held in Honduras to elect the President of Honduras, Vice-President, and deputies to the National Congress of Honduras on 27 November 2005. For the 2005 election the constitution was amended to create a single vice-president (Hondurans previously elected three 'presidential designates' on a ticket along with the presidential candidate). For the 2005 election the system of proportional representation was also changed from a closed list to an open list - the parties also used open-list primaries to select candidate slates. The list system reduced the re-election rate of incumbents, with just 31% of deputies in the new Congress having seats in the 2002–2006 Congress.

zh.s: 2005年11月27日，洪都拉斯举行大选，选举总统、副总统和国会代表。此次选举修订了宪法，设立一名副总统；此前选民会在总统候选人名单中同时选出三名“总统指定人”。选举制度也从封闭式比例代表名单改为开放式名单，各政党还通过开放式初选确定候选人名单。名单制度降低了议员连任率，新一届国会中只有31%的议员曾在2002至2006年国会任职。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Gabon on 27 November 2005. Incumbent President Omar Bongo, in power since 1967 (making him Africa's longest-serving ruler), sought another seven-year term against four other candidates. According to an announcement of results by the country's interior minister, the result was a victory for Bongo, who received 79.2% of the vote. Bongo was sworn in for another seven-year term on 19 January 2006.

zh.s: 2005年11月27日，加蓬举行总统选举。自1967年起执政的现任总统奥马尔·邦戈争取再任7年，与另外4名候选人竞争。根据内政部长公布的结果，邦戈获胜，得票率为79.2%。他于2006年1月19日宣誓就职，开始新的7年任期。

en.s: The 2006 Durand Cup final (or Osian's Durand Cup for sponsorship reason) was the 119th final of the Durand Cup, the oldest football competition in India and third oldest in the world. The final was contested between the two National Football league sides, Dempo SC from Panjim in Goa and JCT FC from Hoshiarpur in Punjab. The tournament was started from 6 November and the final was held on 27 November 2006 in New Delhi.

zh.s: 2006年杜兰德杯决赛是杜兰德杯第119届决赛；该赛事是印度历史最悠久、世界第三古老的足球赛事。决赛由印度国家足球联赛的两支球队交锋，分别是来自果阿邦帕纳吉的邓波体育俱乐部和来自旁遮普邦霍希亚布尔的JCT足球俱乐部。赛事于11月6日开赛，决赛于2006年11月27日在新德里举行。

en.t: 2006 New Zealand National Party leadership election
en.s: The New Zealand National Party leadership election was an election for the National leadership position in 2006 following the resignation of Don Brash.

zh.s: 唐·布拉什辞职后，新西兰国家党于2006年举行党魁选举，选出新的党领导人。

en.s: The Balamorghab ambush occurred on November 27, 2008, when a force of Afghan security forces was attacked by Taliban insurgents. The ambush took place near Balamorghab in Badghis Province, in Northwestern Afghanistan, and resulted in heavy casualties for the government forces. It was described as "one of the most humiliating attacks the Afghan security forces had ever suffered". Badghis province has seen a marked increase in insurgent activity, and while in 2007 the number of Taliban militants was estimated at 200, by 2008 it had grown to over 2,000. In March 2008, an Afghan intelligence operation succeeded in arresting Mawlawi Ghulam Dastagir, one of the principal Taliban commanders in Badghis.

zh.s: 2008年11月27日，阿富汗安全部队遭塔利班武装人员袭击，发生巴拉莫尔加布伏击战。战斗发生在阿富汗西北部巴德吉斯省巴拉莫尔加布附近，政府军伤亡惨重。有人称这是阿富汗安全部队遭受过的“最令人蒙羞的袭击之一”。巴德吉斯省的叛乱活动明显增加：塔利班武装人员据估计从2007年的200多人增至2008年的2,000多人。2008年3月，阿富汗情报行动成功逮捕了巴德吉斯省塔利班主要指挥官之一毛拉维·古拉姆·达斯塔吉尔。

en.s: XL Airways Germany Flight 888T was an acceptance flight for an Airbus A320 on 27 November 2008. The aircraft crashed into the Mediterranean Sea, 7 km (4.3 mi; 3.8 nmi) off Canet-en-Roussillon on the French coast, close to the Spanish border, killing all seven people on board.

zh.s: 德国XL航空888T号班机是空客A320的验收飞行，于2008年11月27日执行。飞机在法国海岸、靠近西班牙边境的卡内昂鲁西永附近海域坠入地中海，距岸约7公里（4.3英里，3.8海里）。机上7人全部遇难。

en.s: The 2009 Nevsky Express bombing occurred on 27 November 2009 when a bomb exploded under a high speed train travelling between the Russian cities of Moscow and Saint Petersburg causing derailment near the town of Bologoye, Tver Oblast (approximately 200 miles or 320 kilometres from Moscow), on the Moscow–Saint Petersburg Railway. The derailment occurred at 21:34 local time (18:34 UTC).

zh.s: 2009年11月27日，一枚炸弹在俄罗斯莫斯科至圣彼得堡的高速列车下方爆炸，列车在特维尔州博洛戈耶镇附近的莫斯科—圣彼得堡铁路上脱轨。脱轨发生在当地时间21时34分（UTC 18时34分）。

en.s: Local elections were held in Taiwan on 27 November 2010 to elect mayors, councillors, and village chiefs of special-municipalities (Kaohsiung, New Taipei, Taichung, Tainan and Taipei), known as the Five Municipalities Elections (Chinese: 五都選舉). Mayoral candidates for the Kuomintang were elected in New Taipei, Taipei, and Taichung, while candidates for the Democratic Progressive Party were elected in Kaohsiung and Tainan.

zh.s: 2010年11月27日，台湾举行地方选举，为高雄、新北、台中、台南和台北五个直辖市选出市长、议员和里长，俗称“五都选举”。国民党候选人在新北、台北和台中当选市长；民主进步党候选人在高雄和台南当选。

en.s: The 2010 Victorian state election, held on Saturday, 27 November 2010, was for the 57th Parliament of Victoria. The election was to elect all 88 members of the Legislative Assembly and all 40 members of the Legislative Council. The incumbent centre-left Labor Party government, led by John Brumby, was defeated by the centre-right Liberal/National Coalition opposition, led by Ted Baillieu.

zh.s: 2010年11月27日星期六，澳大利亚维多利亚州举行选举，选出第57届州议会成员。州议会下院众议院全部88个席位和上院立法委员会全部40个席位改选。由约翰·布伦比领导的中左翼工党政府败给由泰德·贝利厄领导的中右翼自由党与国家党联盟。

en.t: 2013 President of the Chamber of Deputies of the Parliament of the Czech Republic election
en.s: Election of the President of the Chamber of Deputies of the Parliament of the Czech Republic was held on 27 November 2013. Jan Hamáček was elected the new President. Hamáček was the nominee of Czech Social Democratic Party but received support from other coalition parties - ANO 2011, Christian and Democratic Union – Czechoslovak People's Party. Civic Democratic Party (Czech Republic) and TOP 09 also gave him an endorsement.

zh.s: 2013年11月27日，捷克举行众议院议长选举，扬·哈马切克当选新任议长。哈马切克由捷克社会民主党提名，也得到其他联合政府政党的支持，包括ANO 2011和基督教民主联盟—捷克斯洛伐克人民党。公民民主党和TOP 09也表示支持。

en.s: General elections were held in Tonga on 27 November 2014. All twenty-six elected seats in the single-chamber Legislative Assembly were up for election, although the monarch, acting on the advice of his Prime Minister, retains the possibility to appoint members to Cabinet from outside Parliament, thus granting them a non-elected ex officio seat in Parliament. They were the second elections carried out under the May 2010 electoral law, which provided that a majority of Assembly members should be elected by the people, rather than the people and the nobility having equal representation.

zh.s: 2014年11月27日，汤加举行大选，立法议会一院中由选民选出的26个席位全部改选。君主在首相建议下仍可任命议会外人士进入内阁，这些人也会因此自动成为议员。此次是2010年5月选举法通过后的第二次选举。该法规定，议会多数议员应由选民选出，而非由民众和贵族平均分配代表席位。

en.s: On November 27, 2015, a mass shooting occurred in a Planned Parenthood clinic in Colorado Springs, Colorado, resulting in the deaths of three people and injuries to nine. A police officer and two civilians were killed; five police officers and four civilians were injured. After a standoff that lasted five hours, police SWAT teams crashed armored vehicles into the lobby and the attacker surrendered.

zh.t: 科罗拉多斯普林斯计划生育中心枪击案
zh.s: 2015年11月27日，美国科罗拉多州科罗拉多斯普林斯一所计划生育中心发生大规模枪击事件，造成3人死亡、9人受伤。死者包括一名警察和两名平民；伤者包括5名警察和4名平民。对峙持续5小时后，警方特警队开装甲车撞入大厅，袭击者随后投降。

en.s: The 2016–17 Scottish League Cup final was the 71st final of the Scottish League Cup and took place on 27 November 2016 at Hampden Park, Glasgow. The clubs contesting the final were Aberdeen and Celtic, with Celtic winning 3–0. It was their 16th League Cup triumph and the 100th major trophy in their history.

zh.s: 2016—17赛季苏格兰联赛杯决赛是该赛事第71届决赛，于2016年11月27日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园举行。决赛由阿伯丁对阵凯尔特人，凯尔特人以3比0获胜。这是凯尔特人第16次赢得联赛杯，也是该队历史上第100座重要奖杯。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Whittaker vs. Brunson
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Whittaker vs. Brunson (also known as UFC Fight Night 101) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship held on November 27, 2016, at Rod Laver Arena in Melbourne, Australia.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：惠特克对阵布伦森
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：惠特克对阵布伦森又称UFC格斗之夜101，是终极格斗冠军赛主办的综合格斗赛事，于2016年11月27日在澳大利亚墨尔本的罗德·拉沃尔竞技场举行。

en.s: Violence erupted on 26 November 2016 in the town of Kasese, the capital of the Ugandan Kingdom of Rwenzururu, when Ugandan police raided the government offices of the Rwenzururu kingdom, killing eight Rwenzururian royal guards and arresting two others. According to the government of Uganda, the raid was in response to militant attacks on police posts in the region two weeks earlier, allegedly perpetrated by the royal guards.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2016年11月26日，乌干达伦韦恩祖鲁王国首府卡塞塞发生暴力事件。乌干达警方突袭王国政府机关，打死8名王室卫队成员，逮捕另外2人。乌干达政府称，此次突袭是为了回应两周前该地区警察岗哨遭武装人员袭击；据称袭击者是王室卫队成员。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Republicans held a presidential primary election, officially called the open primary of the right and centre (French: primaire ouverte de la droite et du centre), to select a candidate for the 2017 presidential election. It took place on 20 November 2016, with a runoff on 27 November since no candidate obtained at least 50% of the vote in the first round.

zh.s: 共和党举行总统初选，为2017年总统选举选出候选人。这项初选正式名称为“右派与中间派开放初选”（法语：primaire ouverte de la droite et du centre）。首轮投票于2016年11月20日举行；由于没有候选人获得至少50%的选票，第二轮于11月27日举行。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: The 2017 Charlottetown-Parkdale provincial by-election took place on November 27, 2017. The by-election was triggered by the resignation of the district's incumbent MLA Doug Currie on October 19. Green Party candidate Hannah Bell won the election, becoming the second member of the party to be elected to the Legislative Assembly after Peter Bevan-Baker successfully contested the district of Kellys Cross-Cumberland in the 2015 general election.

zh.t: 2017年夏洛特镇—帕克代尔选区补选
zh.s: 2017年11月27日，夏洛特镇—帕克代尔选区举行补选。此前，该选区议员道格·柯里于10月19日辞职。绿党候选人汉娜·贝尔获胜，成为继彼得·贝文-贝克在2015年大选中赢得凯利斯克罗斯—坎伯兰选区后，第二位当选该省议会议员的绿党成员。

en.t: Mississippi holds a runoff for its 2018 US Senate special election
en.s: On November 27, 2018, Mississippi held a runoff in its special election for a US Senate seat. Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith defeated Democrat Mike Espy, receiving 486,769 votes to Espy's 420,819, according to the certified state results. The first round had taken place on November 6.
en.n: November 27 is the runoff date, separate from the November 6 first round.

zh.t: 密西西比州举行2018年联邦参议员补选决选
zh.s: 2018年11月27日，美国密西西比州举行联邦参议员补选决选。州政府公布的认证结果显示，共和党候选人辛迪·海德-史密斯获得486,769票，击败获得420,819票的民主党候选人迈克·埃斯皮。首轮投票是在11月6日。
zh.n: 11月27日是决选日，11月6日举行的是首轮投票。

en.s: General elections were held in Namibia on 27 November 2019. Ballots were cast using electronic voting. A total of eleven candidates ran for the presidency and fifteen political parties contested the National Assembly elections. Hage Geingob of SWAPO was re-elected to the presidency, although his vote share was reduced from 87% in 2014 to 56%, SWAPO's lowest vote share ever for a presidential election.

zh.s: 2019年11月27日，纳米比亚举行大选，投票采用电子方式。共有11名总统候选人参选，15个政党参加国民议会选举。南威党候选人格根布连任总统，但得票率从2014年的87%降至56%，是南威党总统候选人历次参选中的最低得票率。

en.t: Trump signed the bill on November 27, 2019
en.s: The Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act of 2019 (HKHRDA) (S. 1838; Pub. L. 116–76 (text) (PDF)) is a United States federal law that requires the U.S. government to impose sanctions against mainland China and Hong Kong officials considered responsible for human rights abuses in Hong Kong, and requires the United States Department of State and other agencies to conduct an annual review to determine whether changes in Hong Kong's political status (its relationship with mainland China) justify changing the unique, favorable trade relations between the U.S. and Hong Kong.

zh.t: 特朗普签署《香港人权与民主法案》
zh.s: 2019年《香港人权与民主法案》（S. 1838；公法第116-76号）是美国联邦法律，要求美国政府制裁被认定对香港侵犯人权负有责任的中国内地和香港官员，并要求美国国务院等机构每年审查香港政治地位及其与中国内地关系的变化，判断是否需要调整美国与香港之间的特殊优惠贸易关系。

en.s: The 2020 CAF Champions League final, known as The Final of the Century was the final of the 2019–20 CAF Champions League, the 56th edition of Africa's premier club football tournament organized by the Confederation of African Football (CAF), and the 24th edition under the current CAF Champions League title. For the first time, the final was played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CAF.

zh.s: 2020年非洲足联冠军联赛决赛又称“世纪之战”，是2019—2020赛季非洲足联冠军联赛的决赛，也是非洲足联主办的非洲顶级俱乐部赛事第56届赛事中、以“非洲足联冠军联赛”名义举行的第24届决赛。这是该赛事首次在非洲足联预先选定的场地以单场决胜的方式举行。

en.t: Days after the announcement of its discovery, the Utah monolith is removed by recreationists
en.s: The Utah monolith was a metal pillar that stood in a slot canyon in northern San Juan County, Utah, United States. The pillar was 9.5 ft (2.9 m) tall and made of metal sheets riveted into a triangular prism. It was unlawfully placed on public land between July and October 2016, where it stood unnoticed for over four years until its discovery and removal in late 2020.

zh.t: 犹他州单体金属柱被移走
zh.s: 犹他州单体金属柱是一根金属柱，位于美国犹他州圣胡安县北部的一处狭缝峡谷中，高9.5英尺（2.9米），由金属板铆接成三棱柱。它于2016年7月至10月间被非法放置在公共土地上，四年多无人注意，直到2020年末才被发现并移走。

en.t: Iranian nuclear scientist Mohsen Fakhrizadeh is killed near Tehran
en.s: On November 27, 2020, Iranian nuclear scientist Mohsen Fakhrizadeh was killed while travelling through Absard in Tehran province. He was a senior figure associated with Iran's nuclear program. The Iranian government reported the killing to the United Nations Security Council that day.
en.n: The date and place of the killing are documented; responsibility and method remain disputed in public accounts.

zh.t: 伊朗核科学家穆赫辛·法赫里扎德在德黑兰附近遇害
zh.s: 2020年11月27日，伊朗核科学家穆赫辛·法赫里扎德在德黑兰省阿卜萨德附近遇袭身亡。他曾参与伊朗核计划。伊朗政府当天向联合国安理会通报了这起事件。
zh.n: 遇害日期和地点有记录；公开说法对实施者和袭击方式仍有分歧。

This was the 62nd edition of the Copa Libertadores, the top-tier South American continental club football tournament organized by CONMEBOL. The match was played on 27 November 2021 at the Estadio Centenario in Montevideo, Uruguay, between Brazilian sides Palmeiras and Flamengo.

en.s: On 27 November 2024, a coalition of Syrian opposition groups called the Military Operations Command, led by Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and supported by allied Turkish-backed groups in the Syrian National Army (SNA), launched an offensive against the Ba'athist regime's armed forces in Aleppo and Hama Governorates in Syria. Codenamed Deterrence of Aggression by HTS, this was the first military offensive campaign launched by opposition forces in the Syrian civil war since the March 2020 Idlib ceasefire.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，由叙利亚反对派团体组成的军事行动指挥部发动攻势，进攻叙利亚阿勒颇省和哈马省的复兴党政府军。该联盟由沙姆解放组织领导，并得到叙利亚国民军中土耳其支持派别的支援。沙姆解放组织将此次行动命名为“遏制侵略”。这是自2020年3月伊德利卜停火以来，叙利亚内战中反对派发动的首次军事攻势。
