en.s: The 2024 Central Papua gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of Central Papua for a five-year term. It was the first gubernatorial election for the province since its creation in 2022. The election was won by Meki Fritz Nawipa of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P) with 45% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：中巴布亚省省长选举，选出任期五年的省长。该省于2022年成立，这是成立后首次举行省长选举。印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人梅基·弗里茨·纳维帕获胜，得票率为45%。

en.s: The 2024 Bekasi regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Bekasi Regency for a five-year term. PDI-P candidate Ade Kuswara Kunang managed to secure a plurality of votes in a three-way election, defeating former regency legislator BN Holik Qodratullah and former acting regent Dani Ramdan.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：勿加泗县县长选举，选出任期五年的县长。印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人阿德·库斯瓦拉·库南在三人角逐中赢得最多选票，击败前县议员BN·霍利克·科德拉图拉和前代理县长达尼·拉姆丹。

en.s: The 2024 Central Kalimantan gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of Central Kalimantan for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Agustiar Sabran of the Gerindra Party won the election with 37% of the vote. The Democratic Party's Nadalsyah, a former regent of North Barito, placed second with 36%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：中加里曼丹省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。格林德拉党候选人阿古斯蒂亚尔·萨布兰获胜，得票率为37%。民主党候选人纳达尔西亚是北巴里托县前县长，排名第二，得票率为36%。

en.s: The 2024 West Kutai regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of simultaneous nationwide local elections in order to elected the regent and vice regent of West Kutai, East Kalimantan, for the 2025–2030 term. Frederick Edwin, a businessman and son of former regent Ismail Thomas, defeated two other candidates after securing 37,282 votes (39.6%).

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国同步地方选举，选出东加里曼丹省西库台县2025至2030年任期的县长和副县长。商人弗雷德里克·埃德温是前县长伊斯梅尔·托马斯之子，他以37,282票（39.6%）击败另外两名候选人。

en.s: The 2024 West Nusa Tenggara gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of West Nusa Tenggara for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. Lalu Muhamad Iqbal, a former ambassador to Turkey, won the election with 41% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西努沙登加拉省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。前驻土耳其大使拉卢·穆罕默德·伊克巴尔获胜，得票率为41%。

en.s: The 2024 North Sulawesi gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 to elect the governor of North Sulawesi for a five-year term. They were held as part of local elections across Indonesia. The previous election was held in 2020. The election was won by Yulius Selvanus of the Gerindra Party with 36% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚各地举行地方选举，选出北苏拉威西省任期五年的省长。格林德拉党候选人尤利乌斯·塞尔瓦努斯获胜，得票率为36%。

en.s: The 2024 Denpasar mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect both the mayor and vice mayor of Denpasar, Bali, Indonesia, for a five-year term (2025–2030). The previous election was held in 2020. Former Mayor I Gusti Ngurah Jaya Negara of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P) won the election in a landslide with 74% of the vote, securing a second term.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举，选出巴厘岛登巴萨市2025至2030年任期的市长和副市长。前市长、印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人伊·古斯蒂·恩古拉·贾亚·内加拉以74%的得票率大胜，成功连任。

en.s: The 2024 Batu mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Batu City for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2017. Nurochman of the National Awakening Party (PKB) won the election, receiving 50% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举，选出巴图市任期五年的市长和副市长。上次选举于2017年举行。民族觉醒党候选人努罗赫曼获胜，得票率为50%。

en.s: The 2024 Kediri mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Kediri, East Java for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. Vinanda Prameswati, the Golkar candidate, won the election with 56% of the vote, becoming the youngest elected mayor in the 2024 local election cycle.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：东爪哇省谏义里市市长和副市长选举，选出任期五年的市长和副市长。上次选举于2018年举行。戈尔卡尔党候选人维南达·普拉梅斯瓦蒂获胜，得票率为56%，并成为2024年地方选举周期中当选时最年轻的市长。

en.s: The 2024 Bekasi mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Bekasi for a five-year term. The election was won by Tri Adhianto Tjahyono of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P) with 47% of the vote. Former member of the West Java Regional House of Representatives, Heri Koswara of the Prosperous Justice Party (PKS), placed second with 46%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：勿加泗市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人特里·阿迪安托·查约诺获胜，得票率为47%。西爪哇省议会前议员、繁荣正义党候选人赫里·科斯瓦拉排名第二，得票率为46%。

en.s: The 2024 West Kalimantan gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 to elect the governor and vice governor of West Kalimantan for a five-year term. The election was held as part of local elections for governors, regents, and mayors across 36 other provinces in Indonesia. Sutarmidji, the previous elected governor, was eligible to run for a second term.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，西加里曼丹省举行省长和副省长选举，任期五年。此次选举是印度尼西亚36个省同步地方选举的一部分。上一任民选省长苏塔尔米吉可以竞选连任。

en.s: The 2024 Bojonegoro regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Bojonegoro Regency, East Java, for a five-year term. Previous regent Anna Mu'awanah did not contest the election, having been elected into the House of Representatives. In the election, Advanced Indonesia Coalition-backed candidate Setyo Wahono defeated PDI-P candidate Teguh Haryono in a landslide, winning nearly 90 percent of votes.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：东爪哇省博约内戈罗县县长选举，任期五年。前县长安娜·穆阿瓦娜没有参选，因为她已当选国会议员。获得前进印度尼西亚联盟支持的塞蒂奥·瓦霍诺大胜印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人特古·哈里约诺，得票接近90%。

en.s: The 2024 Bandung regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Bandung Regency for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Incumbent regent Dadang Supriatna managed to secure a second term, winning 55.85% of votes after defeating his previous deputy.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：万隆县县长选举，选出任期五年的县长。上次选举于2020年举行。现任县长达当·苏普里亚特纳击败前副县长，成功连任，得票率为55.85%。

en.s: The 2024 Tasikmalaya mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor of Tasikmalaya, West Java for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2017. The election was won by the Gerindra Party's Viman Alfarizi Ramadhan, a member of the West Java Regional House of Representatives, who received 48% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西爪哇省塔西克马拉亚市市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2017年举行。格林德拉党候选人维曼·阿尔法里齐·拉马丹获胜，得票率为48%。他是西爪哇省议会议员。

en.s: The 2024 Bengkayang regental election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Bengkayang Regency in West Kalimantan for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Incumbent regent Sebastianus Darwis ran in an uncontested election and won 71.10 percent of the votes against the blank box option.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西加里曼丹省本卡扬县县长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。现任县长塞巴斯蒂亚努斯·达尔维斯在没有对手的选举中获胜，获得71.10%的选票，空白选项票数不及他。

en.s: The 2024 South Papua gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of South Papua for a five-year term. It was the first gubernatorial election for the province since its formation in 2022. Apolo Safanpo won the election with 51% of the vote, defeating three other candidates. Former Merauke Regent Romanus Mbaraka of the NasDem Party placed second, receiving 25%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：南巴布亚省省长选举，选出任期五年的省长。这是该省2022年成立以来首次举行省长选举。阿波洛·萨凡波获胜，得票率为51%，击败另外3名候选人。纳斯德姆党候选人、梅劳克县前县长罗马努斯·姆巴拉卡排名第二，得票率为25%。

en.s: The 2024 Banyuwangi regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Banyuwangi Regency, East Java for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Incumbent regent Ipuk Fiestiandani managed to secure her second term.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：东爪哇省巴纽旺宜县县长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。现任县长伊普克·菲斯蒂安达尼成功连任。

en.s: The 2024 Cirebon regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Cirebon Regency for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：井里汶县县长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。

en.s: The 2024 Riau gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of Riau for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. The election was won by former House of Representatives member Abdul Wahid of the National Awakening Party (PKB), who received 44% of the vote. The Democratic Party's Muhammad Nasir placed second with 31%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：廖内省省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。民族觉醒党候选人阿卜杜勒·瓦希德获胜，得票率为44%。民主党候选人穆罕默德·纳西尔排名第二，得票率为31%。

en.s: The 2024 Southeast Sulawesi gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of Southeast Sulawesi for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. Andi Sumangerukka of the United Development Party (PPP) won the election with 52% of the vote. The NasDem Party's Tina Nur Alam, a former member of the House of Representatives, placed second with 20%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：东南苏拉威西省省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。团结发展党候选人安迪·苏曼格鲁卡获胜，得票率为52%。纳斯德姆党候选人蒂娜·努尔·阿拉姆曾任国会议员，排名第二，得票率为20%。

en.s: The 2024 Cirebon mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Cirebon, West Java for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2017. Golkar's Effendi Edo won the election, receiving 50% of the vote. Former Mayor Eti Herawati of the NasDem Party placed second with 30%, followed by Dani Mardani of the National Mandate Party (PAN), who received 18%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西爪哇省井里汶市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2017年举行。戈尔卡尔党候选人埃芬迪·埃多获胜，得票率为50%。纳斯德姆党前市长埃蒂·赫拉瓦蒂排名第二，得票率为30%；国民使命党候选人达尼·马尔达尼排名第三，得票率为18%。

en.s: The 2024 Bogor mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Bogor for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. Former Vice Mayor Dedie Rachim of the National Mandate Party (PAN) won the election, securing 36% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：茂物市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。国民使命党候选人、前副市长德迪·拉希姆获胜，得票率为36%。

en.s: The 2024 Banda Aceh mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Banda Aceh for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2017. Illiza Sa'aduddin Djamal of the United Development Party (PPP), who served as mayor from 2014 to 2017, won the election, receiving 41.24% of the vote and defeating the previous mayor who had beaten her in the 2017 election, Aminullah Usman.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：班达亚齐市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2017年举行。团结发展党候选人伊利扎·萨阿丁·贾马尔曾于2014至2017年担任市长，她赢得选举，得票率为41.24%。她击败了曾在2017年选举中击败她的前市长阿明乌拉·乌斯曼。

en.s: The 2024 Bandung mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the Mayor of Bandung for a five-year term. Former television presenter and House of Representatives member Muhammad Farhan of the NasDem Party won the election with 44% of the vote, defeating three other candidates. Haru Suandharu of the Prosperous Justice Party (PKS) placed second with 36%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：万隆市市长选举，任期五年。前电视节目主持人、国会议员、纳斯德姆党候选人穆罕默德·法尔汉获胜，得票率为44%，击败另外3名候选人。繁荣正义党候选人哈鲁·苏安达鲁排名第二，得票率为36%。

en.s: The 2024 Bandar Lampung mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Bandar Lampung for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Mayor Eva Dwiana won a landslide re-election, securing 74% of the vote. She defeated Reihana, a former head of the Bandar Lampung Health Department, who received 25%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：班达楠榜市市长和副市长选举。现任市长埃娃·德维安娜以74%的得票率大胜并连任，击败班达楠榜卫生局前局长雷哈娜，后者得票率为25%。

en.s: The 2024 Pekanbaru mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of the city of Pekanbaru, Riau for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2017. The election was won by former deputy speaker of the Riau Regional House of Representatives, Agung Nugroho of the Democratic Party, who received 46% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：廖内省北干巴鲁市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2017年举行。民主党候选人、廖内省议会前副议长阿贡·努格罗霍获胜，得票率为46%。

en.s: A mayoral election was held in Malang, East Java on 27 November 2024 to elect the mayor and vice mayor for a five-year term. They were held as part of local elections across Indonesia. The previous election was held in 2018. Wahyu Hidayat of the Gerindra Party was elected mayor, with Ali Muthohirin becoming his vice mayor.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚东爪哇省玛琅市举行市长和副市长选举，任期五年。此次选举是印度尼西亚各地地方选举的一部分。上次选举于2018年举行。格林德拉党候选人瓦休·希达亚特当选市长，阿里·穆托希林当选副市长。

en.s: The 2024 Singkawang mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor of Singkawang for a five-year term. Previous mayor Tjhai Chui Mie managed to secure a second term in a three-way race.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：新加旺市市长选举，任期五年。前市长蔡翠媚在三人角逐中成功连任。

en.s: The 2024 Surakarta mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Surakarta, Central Java for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Respati Ardi of the Gerindra Party won the election in a landslide, securing 60% of the vote. He defeated incumbent mayor Teguh Prakosa of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P), who received 39%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：中爪哇省梭罗市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。格林德拉党候选人雷斯帕蒂·阿尔迪以60%的得票率大胜，击败得票率为39%的现任市长、印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人特古·普拉科萨。

en.s: The 2024 Depok mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Depok for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Gerindra Party member Supian Suri won the election with 53% of the vote, ending nearly 20 years of Prosperous Justice Party (PKS) control of the municipal government.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：德波市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。格林德拉党成员苏皮安·苏里获胜，得票率为53%，结束了繁荣正义党对市政府近20年的控制。

en.s: Mayoral elections were held in Palembang on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. Ratu Dewa, a former acting mayor, won the election with 46% of the vote. Yudha Pratomo placed second with 30%, followed by former Vice Mayor Fitrianti Agustinda of the NasDem Party, who received 23%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：巨港市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。前代理市长拉图·德瓦获胜，得票率为46%。尤达·普拉托莫排名第二，得票率为30%；纳斯德姆党前副市长菲特里安蒂·阿贡斯丁达排名第三，得票率为23%。

en.s: The 2024 Kuningan regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Kuningan Regency for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：库宁安县县长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。

en.s: The 2024 South Bangka regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of South Bangka Regency in the Bangka Belitung Islands for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Incumbent regent Riza Herdavid ran in an uncontested election and won 81.27 percent of the votes against the blank box option.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：邦加勿里洞群岛南邦加县县长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。现任县长里扎·赫达维德在没有对手的选举中获胜，得票率为81.27%，其余选票投给空白选项。

en.s: The 2024 Bangka Belitung Islands gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of the Bangka Belitung Islands for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2017. Former Vice Governor Hidayat Arsani of Golkar secured a narrow victory, receiving 50% of the vote.

zh.t: 2024年邦加勿里洞群岛省长选举
zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：邦加勿里洞群岛省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2017年举行。戈尔卡尔党候选人、前副省长希达亚特·阿尔萨尼以50%的得票率险胜。

en.s: The 2024 Balikpapan mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Balikpapan, East Kalimantan for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Mayor Rahmad Mas'ud of Golkar won the election in a landslide with 59% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：东加里曼丹省巴厘巴板市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。戈尔卡尔党候选人、现任市长拉赫马德·马苏德以59%的得票率大胜。

en.s: The 2024 Banten gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of Banten for a five-year term. The previous elected governor, Wahidin Halim, did not run for a second term. The speaker of the Banten Regional House of Representatives, Andra Soni of the Gerindra Party, was elected governor with 55% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：万丹省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。前任民选省长瓦希丁·哈利姆没有争取连任。万丹省议会议长、格林德拉党候选人安德拉·索尼以55%的得票率当选省长。

en.s: The 2024 South Tangerang mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of South Tangerang for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Mayor Benyamin Davnie of Golkar defeated Prosperous Justice Party-backed challenger Ruhamaben in a landslide, securing a second term.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：南唐格朗市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。戈尔卡尔党现任市长贝尼亚明·达夫尼击败繁荣正义党支持的挑战者鲁哈马本，大胜并成功连任。

en.s: The 2024 West Java gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the Governor of West Java for the 2025 to 2030 term. The election was held as part of local elections for governors, regents, and mayors across 36 other provinces in Indonesia.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西爪哇省长选举，选出2025至2030年任期的省长。此次选举是印度尼西亚36个省举行地方选举的一部分。

en.s: An election of the mayor and vice mayor of Serang, Banten, for a five-year term, was held on 27 November 2024. The election was held alongside nationwide local elections. The previous election was held in 2018. City legislator Budi Rustandi of the Gerindra Party won the election in a landslide, defeating former mayor Syafrudin Syafe'i of the National Mandate Party (PAN), and Golkar candidate Ratu Ria Maryana.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，万丹省西冷市举行市长和副市长选举，任期五年。此次选举与印度尼西亚全国地方选举同时举行。上次选举于2018年举行。格林德拉党候选人、城市议员布迪·鲁斯坦迪大胜，击败民族使命党前市长夏夫鲁丁·夏菲和戈尔卡尔党候选人拉图·里亚·玛丽亚娜。

en.s: The 2024 West Papua gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of West Papua province for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2017. Former Governor Dominggus Mandacan was elected unopposed.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西巴布亚省省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2017年举行。前省长多明古斯·曼达坎在没有对手的情况下当选。

en.s: The 2024 Central Java gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of Central Java for a five-year term. The election was contested by former Commander of the Indonesian National Armed Forces Andika Perkasa, primarily backed by the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P), and former provincial chief of police Ahmad Luthfi, backed by a wide coalition of parties led by Luthfi's Gerindra Party.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：中爪哇省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。候选人包括前印尼国民军总司令安迪卡·佩尔卡萨（主要由印度尼西亚民主斗争党支持），以及前省警察总长艾哈迈德·卢特菲（由格林德拉党领导的广泛政党联盟支持）。

en.s: The 2024 East Nusa Tenggara gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of East Nusa Tenggara for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. The election was won by Emanuel Melkiades Laka Lena of Golkar with 37% of the vote. Yohanis Fransiskus Lema of the Indonesian Democratic Party Struggle (PDI-P) received 32%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：东努沙登加拉省省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。戈尔卡尔党候选人埃马努埃尔·梅尔基亚德斯·拉卡·莱纳获胜，得票率为37%。印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人约哈尼斯·弗兰西斯库斯·莱马得票率为32%。

en.s: The 2024 Papua gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of Papua province for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. It was the first gubernatorial election in Papua since the province's partition in 2022. Former Jayapura Mayor Benhur Tomi Mano of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P) secured 50% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：巴布亚省省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。这是巴布亚省2022年划分后首次举行省长选举。印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人、前查亚普拉市长本胡尔·托米·马诺获得50%的选票。

en.s: The 2024 Lampung gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of Lampung for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. Former member of the Lampung Regional House of Representatives, Rahmat Mirzani Djausal of the Gerindra Party, won the election in a landslide with 82% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：楠榜省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。格林德拉党候选人、楠榜省议会前议员拉赫马特·米尔扎尼·贾乌萨尔以82%的得票率大胜。

en.s: The 2024 Garut regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Garut Regency for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：加鲁特县县长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。

en.s: The 2024 Padang mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Padang, West Sumatra for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. Former Padang Panjang Mayor Fadly Amran of the NasDem Party won the election with 55% of the vote. He defeated former Mayor Hendri Septa of the National Mandate Party (PAN), who received 27%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西苏门答腊省巴东市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。纳斯德姆党候选人、前巴东班让市长法德利·安兰获胜，得票率为55%。他击败了得票率为27%的前市长亨德里·塞普塔，后者来自国民使命党。

en.s: The 2024 Central Sulawesi gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of Central Sulawesi for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. The election was won by former House of Representatives Member Anwar Hafid of the Democratic Party with 45% of the vote. The runner up, Ahmad Ali of the NasDem Party, received 38%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：中苏拉威西省省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。民主党候选人、前国会议员安瓦尔·哈菲德获胜，得票率为45%。纳斯德姆党候选人艾哈迈德·阿里排名第二，得票率为38%。

en.s: The 2024 Acehnese gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of Aceh for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2017. The election was won by former Vice Governor Muzakir Manaf of the Aceh Party with 53% of the vote. His sole opponent, Bustami Hamzah of NasDem, received 46%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：亚齐省省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2017年举行。亚齐党候选人、前副省长穆扎基尔·马纳夫获胜，得票率为53%。他唯一的对手、纳斯德姆党候选人布斯塔米·哈姆扎得票率为46%。

en.s: The 2024 South Kalimantan gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of South Kalimantan for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Incumbent Governor Muhidin of the National Mandate Party (PAN) won the election in a landslide with 82% of the vote. Muhidin succeeded Sahbirin Noor in 2024 following the latter's resignation.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：南加里曼丹省省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。国民使命党籍现任省长穆希丁以82%的得票率大胜。穆希丁于2024年接替辞职的沙赫比林·努尔出任省长。

en.s: The 2024 Malang regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Malang Regency for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Incumbent regent Sanusi of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle successfully won a second term, defeating Golkar-backed candidate Gunawan HS.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：玛琅县县长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。印度尼西亚民主斗争党籍现任县长萨努西成功连任，击败获得戈尔卡尔党支持的候选人古纳万·HS。

en.s: The 2024 Sangihe Islands regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of the Sangihe Islands Regency, North Sulawesi for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2017. NasDem Party candidate Michael Thungari managed to defeat three other candidates to win the election, including previous regent Jabes Ezer Gaghana and previous acting regent Rinny Tamuntuan.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：北苏拉威西省桑义赫群岛县县长和副县长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2017年举行。纳斯德姆党候选人迈克尔·通加里击败另外3名候选人获胜，其中包括前县长贾贝斯·埃泽尔·加加纳和前代理县长里妮·塔蒙图安。

en.s: The 2024 Riau Islands gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of the Riau Islands for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Incumbent Governor Ansar Ahmad of Golkar won re-election with 55% of the vote. His sole opponent, Batam Mayor Muhammad Rudi of the NasDem Party, received 44%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：廖内群岛省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。戈尔卡尔党籍现任省长安萨尔·艾哈迈德以55%的得票率连任。纳斯德姆党候选人、巴淡市市长穆罕默德·鲁迪是唯一对手，得票率为44%。

en.s: The 2024 Highland Papua gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of Highland Papua for a five-year term. It was the first gubernatorial for the province since its formation in 2022. The election was won by Mamberamo Raya Regent John Tabo of Golkar with 56% of the vote. His sole opponent, Befa Yigibalom, received 43%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：高地巴布亚省省长选举，任期五年。这是该省2022年成立以来首次举行省长选举。戈尔卡尔党候选人、马姆贝拉莫拉亚县县长约翰·塔博获胜，得票率为56%。他的唯一对手贝法·伊吉巴洛姆得票率为43%。

en.s: The 2024 Bengkulu gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of Bengkulu for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. The election was won by Helmi Hasan of the National Mandate Party (PAN) with 55% of the vote. He defeated former Governor Rohidin Mersyah of Golkar, who received 44%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：明古鲁省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。国民使命党候选人赫尔米·哈桑获胜，得票率为55%。他击败了戈尔卡尔党候选人、前省长罗希丁·梅尔夏，后者得票率为44%。

en.s: The 2024 Medan mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of Indonesian nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Medan for a five-year term. The election was won by Rico Waas of the NasDem Party with 49% of the vote. Ridha Dharmajaya of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P) placed second with 31%, followed by former member of the House of Representatives, Hidayatullah of the Prosperous Justice Party (PKS), who received 19%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：棉兰市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。纳斯德姆党候选人里科·瓦斯获胜，得票率为49%。印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人里达·达尔马贾亚排名第二，得票率为31%；繁荣正义党候选人、前国会议员希达亚图拉得票率为19%。

en.s: The 2024 Manado mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor of Manado, North Sulawesi for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Incumbent Mayor Andrei Angouw managed to secure re-election to a second term, winning 48% of the vote in a four-way race. Golkar-backed former Mayor Jimmy Rimba Rogi placed second and received 44%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：北苏拉威西省万鸦老市市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。现任市长安德烈·安古成功连任，开启第二个任期，在四人角逐中得票率为48%。获得戈尔卡尔党支持的前市长吉米·林巴·罗吉排名第二，得票率为44%。

en.s: The 2024 West Sulawesi gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of West Sulawesi for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2017. The election was won by Suhardi Duka of the Democratic Party with 46% of the vote. He defeated three other candidates, the runner up, former Polewali Mandar Regent Andi Ibrahim Masdar, received 19%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西苏拉威西省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2017年举行。民主党候选人苏哈迪·杜卡获胜，得票率为46%。他击败另外3名候选人；排名第二的波莱瓦利曼达尔县前县长安迪·易卜拉欣·马斯达得票率为19%。

en.s: The 2024 Tangerang mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Tangerang for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. Former Vice Mayor Sachrudin of Golkar won the election with 51% of the vote. Faldo Maldini of the Indonesian Solidarity Party (PSI) placed second with 33%, followed by Ahmad Amarullah of the Prosperous Justice Party (PKS), who received 15%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：丹格朗市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。戈尔卡尔党候选人、前副市长萨赫鲁丁获胜，得票率为51%。印度尼西亚团结党候选人法尔多·马尔迪尼排名第二，得票率为33%；繁荣正义党候选人艾哈迈德·阿马鲁拉得票率为15%。

en.s: The 2024 Gorontalo gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of Gorontalo, Indonesia for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2017. The election was won by Gusnar Ismail of the Democratic Party with 43% of the vote. Former Vice Governor Tonny Uloli of the NasDem Party placed second and received 28%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：哥伦打洛省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2017年举行。民主党候选人古斯纳尔·伊斯梅尔获胜，得票率为43%。纳斯德姆党候选人、前副省长托尼·乌洛利排名第二，得票率为28%。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in North Sumatra on 27 November 2024 alongside other local elections nationwide to elect the governor and vice governor for a five-year term. Medan Mayor Bobby Nasution of the Gerindra Party won the election in a landslide with 64% of the vote. He defeated former Governor Edy Rahmayadi of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P), who received 35%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：北苏门答腊省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。格林德拉党候选人、棉兰市市长博比·纳苏蒂安以64%的得票率大胜。印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人、前省长埃迪·拉赫马亚迪得票率为35%。

en.s: The 2024 Jember regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent and vice of Jember Regency for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Muhammad Fawait of the Gerindra Party won the election, receiving 54% of the vote. He defeated the incumbent regent, Hendy Siswanto of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P), who received 45%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：任抹县县长和副县长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。格林德拉党候选人穆罕默德·法瓦伊特获胜，得票率为54%。他击败了印度尼西亚民主斗争党籍现任县长亨迪·西斯万托，后者得票率为45%。

en.s: The 2024 North Lombok regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of North Lombok Regency, West Nusa Tenggara for a five-year term. With incumbent regent Djohan Sjamsu being ineligible to contest the election, 2016–2021 regent Najmul Akhyar managed to defeat incumbent vice regent Danny Karter Febrianto and PKB candidate Lalu Muchsin Effendi to secure a second term.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西努沙登加拉省北龙目县县长选举，任期五年。现任县长佐汉·沙姆苏没有资格参选。2016至2021年担任县长的纳吉穆尔·阿赫亚尔击败现任副县长丹尼·卡特·费布里安托和民族觉醒党候选人拉卢·穆赫辛·埃芬迪，成功开启第二个任期。

en.s: The 2024 Karawang regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Karawang Regency for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Incumbent regent Aep Syaepuloh secured a second term.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：卡拉旺县县长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。现任县长阿埃普·西亚埃普洛获得连任。

en.s: The 2024 Pamekasan regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Pamekasan Regency, East Java for a five-year term. The previous regent Badrut Tamam failed to participate in the election, which was won by 2008–2013 regent Kholilurrahman.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：东爪哇省帕梅卡桑县县长选举，任期五年。前任县长巴德鲁特·塔曼未能参选。曾于2008至2013年担任县长的霍利鲁尔拉赫曼赢得选举。

en.s: The 2024 Sambas regental election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Sambas Regency in West Kalimantan for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Incumbent regent Satono won against incumbent vice regent Fahrur Rofi and independent candidate Misni Safari.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西加里曼丹省三发县县长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。现任县长萨托诺击败了现任副县长法赫鲁尔·罗菲和独立候选人米斯妮·萨法里。

en.s: The 2024 North Kalimantan gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 to elect the governor and vice governor of North Kalimantan for a five-year term. They were held as part of local elections across Indonesia. The incumbent, Zainal Arifin Paliwang, was re-elected in a landslide with over 58% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行北加里曼丹省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。此次选举是印度尼西亚各地地方选举的一部分。现任省长扎伊纳尔·阿里芬·帕利旺以超过58%的得票率大胜连任。

en.s: The 2024 Jakarta gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 to elect both the governor and vice governor of Jakarta for the 2025 to 2030 term. The election was held as part of local elections for governors, regents, and mayors across 36 other provinces in Indonesia.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行雅加达省省长和副省长选举，选出2025至2030年任期的省长和副省长。此次选举是印度尼西亚36个省举行地方选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2024 North Maluku gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of North Maluku for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. Gubernatorial candidate Benny Laos, a former regent of Morotai Island, died in a speedboat explosion before the election.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：北马鲁古省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。省长候选人本尼·劳斯曾任莫罗泰岛县县长，在选举前死于快艇爆炸事故。

en.s: The 2024 Pontianak mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Pontianak for a five-year term. The election was won by the Gerindra Party's Edi Rusdi Kamtono in a landslide with 80% of the vote. He defeated Mulyadi of Golkar, who received 19%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：坤甸市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。格林德拉党候选人埃迪·鲁斯迪·坎托诺以80%的得票率大胜，击败得票率为19%的戈尔卡尔党候选人穆利亚迪。

en.s: The 2024 Sumenep regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent and vice regent of Sumenep Regency, East Java for a five-year term. Incumbent regent Achmad Fauzi of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P) was re-elected to a second term in a landslide, receiving 60% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：东爪哇省苏梅内普县县长和副县长选举，任期五年。印度尼西亚民主斗争党籍现任县长艾哈迈德·福齐以60%的得票率大胜，连任县长。

en.s: The 2024 Batam mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Batam for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Vice Mayor Amsakar Achmad of the NasDem Party won the election in a landslide, securing 66% of the vote. His sole opponent, Nuryanto of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P), received 33%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：巴淡市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。纳斯德姆党候选人、前副市长阿姆萨卡尔·艾哈迈德以66%的得票率大胜。唯一对手、印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人努里扬托得票率为33%。

en.s: The 2024 North Tapanuli regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of North Tapanuli Regency, North Sumatra for a five-year term. Perindo candidate Jonius Taripar Parsaoran Hutabarat, formerly a member of the North Sumatra Regional House of Representatives, defeated PDI-P candidate and wife of previous regent Satika Simamora in the election.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：北苏门答腊省北塔帕努里县县长选举，任期五年。印尼团结党候选人乔纽斯·塔里帕尔·帕尔索拉安·胡塔巴拉特曾任北苏门答腊省议会议员，他击败了印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人萨蒂卡·西马莫拉；她是前县长的妻子。

en.s: The 2024 Cimahi mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Cimahi, West Java for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2017. Former Mayor Ngatiyana of the National Awakening Party (PKB) won the election with 41% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西爪哇省芝马墟市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2017年举行。民族觉醒党候选人、前市长恩加蒂亚纳获胜，得票率为41%。

en.s: The 2024 West Sumatra gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of West Sumatra for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Incumbent Governor Mahyeldi Ansharullah of the Prosperous Justice Party (PKS) won re-election in a landslide with 77% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西苏门答腊省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。繁荣正义党籍现任省长马赫耶尔迪·安沙鲁拉以77%的得票率大胜连任。

en.s: The 2024 Maluku gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of Maluku for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. The election was won by Hendrik Lewerissa of the Gerindra Party with 47% of the vote. Jeffry Apoly Rahawarin of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P) placed second, receiving 26%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：马鲁古省省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。格林德拉党候选人亨德里克·勒韦里萨获胜，得票率为47%。印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人杰弗里·阿波利·拉哈瓦林排名第二，得票率为26%。

en.s: The 2024 South Sulawesi gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of South Sulawesi for a five-year term. The election was won by former Governor Andi Sudirman Sulaiman of the Gerindra Party with 65% of the vote. His sole opponent, Makassar Mayor Mohammad Ramdhan Pomanto of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P), received 34%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：南苏拉威西省省长选举，任期五年。格林德拉党候选人、前省长安迪·苏迪尔曼·苏莱曼以65%的得票率获胜。唯一对手、印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人、望加锡市长穆罕默德·拉姆丹·波曼托得票率为34%。

en.s: The 2024 East Kalimantan gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of East Kalimantan for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. Former member of the House of Representatives, Rudy Mas'ud of Golkar, won the election with 55% of the vote. He defeated former Governor Isran Noor of the Democratic Party, who received 44%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：东加里曼丹省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。戈尔卡尔党候选人、前国会议员鲁迪·马苏德获胜，得票率为55%。他击败了民主党候选人、前省长伊斯兰·努尔，后者得票率为44%。

en.s: Local executive elections (Indonesian: Pemilihan Kepala Daerah or Pilkada) to elect governors, mayors, and regents in Indonesia were held on 27 November 2024 across 545 regions: 37 provinces, 415 regencies, and 93 cities, which covered all provinces except the Yogyakarta Special Region and all cities/regencies except the constituents of Jakarta. The previous local executive elections were held in 2020.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行地方行政首长选举，包括省长、市长和县长选举，共涉及545个地区：37个省、415个县和93个市。除日惹特区外，所有省份都参加选举；雅加达的组成市和县未举行此类选举。上次地方行政首长选举于2020年举行。

en.s: The 2024 Samarinda mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Samarinda, East Kalimantan for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Mayor Andi Harun of the Gerindra Party was re-elected unopposed with 88% of the vote. Blank ballots accounted for 11% of all valid votes cast.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：东加里曼丹省三马林达市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。格林德拉党籍现任市长安迪·哈伦在没有对手的情况下连任，得票率为88%。空白选项获得全部有效选票的11%。

en.s: The 2024 Semarang mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of the 2024 Indonesian local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Semarang for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. The election was won by Agustina Wilujeng Pramestuti of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P), a former member of the House of Representatives (DPR-RI) who received 57% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行2024年地方选举之一：三宝垄市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。印度尼西亚民主斗争党候选人阿古斯蒂娜·维卢杰恩·普拉梅斯图蒂曾任国会议员，她获胜，得票率为57%。

en.s: Mayoral elections were held in Surabaya on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor for a five-year term. Incumbent Mayor Eri Cahyadi of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P) was re-elected unopposed, securing 81% of the vote. Votes for the blank box option comprised 18% of all valid ballots cast.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：泗水市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。印度尼西亚民主斗争党籍现任市长埃里·查希亚迪在没有对手的情况下连任，得票率为81%。空白选项占全部有效选票的18%。

en.s: The 2024 East Java gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the Governor of East Java for a five-year term. Former Governor Khofifah Indar Parawansa won the election in a landslide with 58% of the vote, although she lost heavily in Surabaya.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：东爪哇省省长选举，任期五年。前省长霍菲法·因达尔·帕拉旺萨大胜，得票率为58%，但她在泗水得票大幅落后。

en.s: The 2024 South Sumatra gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor and vice governor of South Sumatra for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. Former Governor Herman Deru of the NasDem Party won the election with 51% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：南苏门答腊省省长和副省长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。纳斯德姆党候选人、前省长赫尔曼·德鲁获胜，得票率为51%。

en.s: The 2024 Makassar mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Makassar for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Munafri Arifuddin of Golkar won the election with 54% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：望加锡市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2020年举行。戈尔卡尔党候选人穆纳夫里·阿里夫丁获胜，得票率为54%。

en.s: The 2024 Mataram mayoral election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the mayor and vice mayor of Mataram, West Nusa Tenggara for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Incumbent mayor Mohan Roliskana from Golkar and his incumbent deputy Mujiburrahman defeated the Prosperous Justice Party-backed challenger Lalu Aria Dharma, securing a second term.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西努沙登加拉省马塔兰市市长和副市长选举，任期五年。戈尔卡尔党籍现任市长莫汉·罗利斯卡纳和现任副市长穆吉布拉赫曼击败繁荣正义党支持的挑战者拉卢·阿里亚·达尔马，成功连任。

en.s: The 2024 Southwest Papua gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of Southwest Papua for a five-year term. It was the first gubernatorial election for the province since its formation in 2022. Asmat Regent Elisa Kambu won the election with 46% of the vote, defeating four other candidates. Abdul Faris Umlati of the Democratic Party placed second, receiving 25%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：西南巴布亚省省长选举，任期五年。这是该省2022年成立以来首次举行省长选举。阿斯马特县县长埃莉莎·坎布获胜，得票率为46%，击败另外4名候选人。民主党候选人阿卜杜勒·法里斯·乌姆拉蒂排名第二，得票率为25%。

en.s: The 2024 Jambi gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the governor of Jambi for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2020. Governor Al Haris of the National Mandate Party (PAN) won re-election in a landslide with 61% of the vote. His sole opponent Romi Hariyanto, the East Tanjung Jabung regent and fellow PAN member who was nominated by the NasDem Party, received 38%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：占碑省省长选举，任期五年。国民使命党籍省长阿尔·哈里斯以61%的得票率大胜连任。唯一对手罗米·哈里扬托是东丹戎贾布县县长，也是国民使命党成员，但由纳斯德姆党提名，得票率为38%。

en.s: The 2024 Bali gubernatorial election was held on 27 November 2024, as part of 2024 Indonesian local elections across Indonesia, to elect both the governor and vice governor of Bali for a five-year term (2025-2030). Former governor I Wayan Koster of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P) elected for a second term.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行2024年地方选举之一：巴厘省省长和副省长选举，任期为2025至2030年。印度尼西亚民主斗争党前省长伊·瓦扬·科斯特当选，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 2024 Sampang regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Sampang Regency, East Java for a five-year term. The previous regent Slamet Junaidi of the NasDem Party defeated Golkar challenger Muhammad bin Muafi Zaini to secure a second term. During the election's campaigning, a violent incident causing the death of one person resulted in heightened security measures during the voting process.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：东爪哇省桑潘县县长选举，任期五年。纳斯德姆党籍现任县长斯拉梅特·朱奈迪击败戈尔卡尔党挑战者穆罕默德·宾·穆阿菲·扎伊尼，成功连任。竞选期间发生暴力事件，造成一人死亡，因此投票期间加强了安保措施。

en.s: The 2024 Bogor regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the Regent of Bogor Regency for a five-year term. The previous regency election was held in 2018.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：茂物县县长选举，任期五年。上次县级选举于2018年举行。

en.s: The 2024 Tangerang regency election was held on 27 November 2024 as part of nationwide local elections to elect the regent of Tangerang Regency for a five-year term. The previous election was held in 2018. Maesyal Rasyid won the election in a landslide with 65% of the vote. He defeated former Vice Regent Mad Romli, who received 30%.

zh.s: 2024年11月27日，印度尼西亚举行全国地方选举之一：丹格朗县县长选举，任期五年。上次选举于2018年举行。梅西亚尔·拉希德以65%的得票率大胜，击败得票率为30%的前副县长马德·罗姆利。
